customItems.name: Revelwood Gem Forge

customItems.name: Nomad Highlands Gem Forge

customItems.name: Kindlewastes Gem Forge

items.description: A precisely formulated mana potion that instantly restores a massive amount of mana upon use.
items.name: Superior Mana Potion

items.description: A traditional garment which was historically worn by esteemed battle mages. Now, their ritualistic nature is a faint memory at best.
items.name: Warlock Shirt

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Round Stone Window Frame

items.description: A set of crystal eyes adorns this weapon, seeking the weak points of your foes. The handle has been decorated with overlapping leather straps.
items.name: Hammer Of The Piercing Gaze

items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home. Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Standing Torch

items.description: Airy, slightly billowing pants that allow the wearer to feel the heat of the wind.
items.name: Ashwind Strider Pants

items.description: A twisted wand emitting a faint, blue light. It demands to be wielded! Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.
items.name: Reaper's Wand

items.description: A dusty overcoat that reveals a metal exoskeleton beneath. A perfectly spherical cavity lies at the very centre of the chest plate, waiting to be adorned with an energy core.
items.name: Artificer's Chest

items.description:
Countless cankerous growths sprout from this leather armor, thus forging it in a new image.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.
items.name: Plaguebringer Chest

items.description: A decorative item that can be placed in any building. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Crude Wooden Stool

items.description: A twisted wand emitting a faint, blue light. It demands to be wielded! Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.
items.name: Reaper's Wand

items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home. Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Blue Wall Light I

items.description: With just some meat, a forest beet, and a small fire, you can make this nutritious skewer anywhere and at any time.
items.name: Meat and Forest Beet Skewer

items.description: A staple in many traditional Revelwood dishes. It has a rejuvenating effect.
items.name: Grilled Game

items.description: This ring will increase your mana and its replenishment.
items.name: Lesser Ring of Mana

items.description: A weapon born from the amalgamation of bones, earth, and liquid fire. As your eyes travel across it, the mess of cartilage and moss at the hilt gives way to a light-swallowing obsidian blade.
items.name: Chimerical Greatsword

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: "Round-Billed Sailer On One Leg"

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Spider Web I

items.description: A crude industrial oven for sintering and heating.
items.name: Kiln

items.description: An axe named after a small moon that orbits a red planet, tirelessly drifting through the void... somewhere far, far away from the valleys you call home.
items.name: Axe Of Deimos

items.description: Hide passages in your base behind this secret door.
items.name: Secret Castle Door

items.description: A decorative item that can be placed in any building. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Maritime Bathtub

items.description: This handpan is a true rarity, ornamented with striking red tones.
items.name: Ornate Handpan

items.description: These gloves lock your hold on the bow — target the head with steady aim.
items.name: Skull Stalker Gloves

items.description: Some scratched up Mercenary Boots. Kick your enemies when they're down!
items.name: Mercenary Boots

items.description:
A big and heavy chest that offers fantastic storage space for countless items.

The items stored here can be used for crafting purposes from anywhere in the base!
items.name: Enormous Magic Chest

items.description: Beautifully tender, juicy meat. It fills the belly and warms the soul by providing better frost resistance!
items.name: Grilled Fatty Meat

items.description: A rising phoenix thrones above this helmet, protecting your steadfast gaze under its wings. It's a stern reminder of your destiny and the eternity it bears.
items.name: Vanguard Helmet

items.description: A throwable light that activates upon landing, even underwater. Not as strong as other light sources.
items.name: Gleam Root Diving Light

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Flag Pole I

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Veilwater Basin Boardwalk I

items.description: A wig head that unlocks more haircuts once picked up. It can also be placed in your base as decoration.
items.name: Wig Head

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Small Stone Arc

items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
items.name: Flax Seedling

items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
items.name: Sugar Cane Seedling

items.description: A sturdy shield, graced by the visage of a bird.
items.name: Hero's Shield

items.description:
He spun, he threw his scrap balls, and drank his way through every fight he had. But in the end, none of it was enough. This trophy is proof of your victory.

Collect multiple Scavenger Scattershot Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.
items.name: Gold Scavenger Scattershot Trophy

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Graveyard Fence

items.description: A belted chest armor piece that's marked by thick, linear grooves and ridges that stretch towards the sun. It is adorned with violet trim that elevates the construction and creates a pleasing color palette reminiscent of the hues of the Mother Flame.
items.name: Crestflame Chest

items.description: A complex weaving machine which allows the manufucture of fabric.
items.name: Loom

items.description: A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home. There are words written on the back: "But from the depths of the Wells an unforeseen curse swept into Embervale." A horrible nightmare of mine. I could not rest until I had put it to canvas... but now, I can't stand to look at it. -J
items.name: A Spiral Down, Down, Down

items.description: This forgotten piece of armor is covered in dried blood and shrouded in darkness. Maybe it should have stayed lost.
items.name: Gloom Monarch Trousers

items.description: Crude, but easily crafted storage. It holds space for a few items.
items.name: Tiny Chest

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Small Boreal Wood Cupboard

items.description:
Grayish green hues combined with a dusty rose color.

This color palette can be made with Springlands materials.
items.name: Windy Fields

items.description: A hammer that has been further improved by an added goat horn in the back. Only the finest, most sturdy horns are selected!
items.name: Goat Hammer

items.description: A cleaver coated with acid and bile, swung by Scavenger Butchers. Its victims can mend the bleeding — but rarely stop the toxins from spreading.
items.name: Acid Cleaver

items.description: A Bronze Block commonly utilized in art and science. It inspires greatness when used as a building material.
items.name: Bronze Block

items.description: An agile shield that feels as though it could be used well offensively. Three small dots adorn its heart, representing humanity, the Ancients, and the Flameborn between.
items.name: Emberguard Shield

items.description: An Ancient block that creates walls with a subtle yet distinct scallop pattern. It is most frequently used inside Ancient Spires.
items.name: Ancient Dungeon Block

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Bamboo Palm Leaf Umbrella

items.description: A gray building block that's marked by the radial shapes and gold circles traditionally associated with Ancient crafts.
items.name: Ancient Circles Block

items.description: A majestic staff topped with an ouroboros ornament made from green jade. It's perfect for honoring the year of the snake. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.
items.name: Staff Of The Serpent

items.description: Born from unimaginable heat and weight, diamond endures what would destroy anything else. Every facet tells a different story.
items.name: Diamond

items.description: Releases continuous healing projectiles that automatically seek you and your allies. Channel Spell: Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.
items.name: Eternal Heal Cascade II

items.description: Seamlessly matching the rest of your outfit, these shoes let nothing stand between you and your goal.
items.name: Skull Stalker Shoes

items.description: A traditional Ancient tool used to adjust the subject's physical matter or shell after arrival. It can also be used to unleash the full wonder of blunt force trauma. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.
items.name: Proto Matter-Bender

items.description: Targeting an enemy for a few seconds while aiming or blocking puts a mark on the enemy. Attacking the marked enemy deals %k additional fire damage. The mark can stack up to 3 times by continued targeting, increasing the bonus damage by %k at 2 stacks and %k at 3 stacks.
items.name: Gem of Focused Light

items.description: A heavy helmet, adorned with the imposing horns of a bull and a tall, far-reaching crest. The faceplate only leaves room for the eyes, letting the wearer's red-hot anger radiate outwards.
items.name: Brazen Bull Helmet

items.description: This item will dispense water endlessly until it is submerged.
items.name: Metal Water Dispenser I

items.description: The sugar rush powers your stamina regeneration for a short amount of time.
items.name: Purple Berry Cake

items.description: An axe made for cutting down trees. Slightly less effective for fighting off wolves.
items.name: Fenrig's Axe

items.description: Rays of steel stretch outward from the sword handle's guard. They resemble the final light of the sun before an eclipse. Shroud Imbued: This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs.
items.name: Eclipsed Blade

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Bembel Pitcher

items.description: An azure gem, curved guard, and gold-patterened edge embellish this sword. All in all, it is both beautiful and deadly.
items.name: Goldlaced Greatsword

items.description:
A fine drum with a patterned leather cover, famously owned by Daniel the Damned, a former member of the Honeydews. Fans speculated that the back of the drum was inscribed with runes that would make Daniel play faster, like a possessed man.

Now that you're holding it, those rumors prove to be false — but his damnation was very real, at least!
items.name: Ornate Hand Drum

items.description:
Bold as midday sun, tempered by white and grounded in black.

This palette can be made with Cinder's Cradle materials.
items.name: Light And Shadow

items.description: These improved archery gloves make it easier to shoot birds straight out of the sky! There are hardly any birds these days, though.
items.name: Sharpshooter Gloves

items.description: Crispy fish tacos filled with a hearty plantain rice.
items.name: Fish Tacos

items.description: The edge of these daggers is shaped like the beak of a soaring eagle, willing to strike down toward its enemies. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.
items.name: Falk Fall Daggers

items.description: Ignites a flash of light, bright enough to push back enemies around the caster. It also deals Stamina Damage based on your Intelligence attribute to Shroud infested enemies which fills their Stun Bar. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.
items.name: Eternal Light Burst I

items.description: These padded trousers have been hastily stitched at the seams. Despite that, they hold up well.
items.name: Tank Trousers

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Crude Wooden Gate II

items.description: This ring will increase your health and healing rate.
items.name: Ultimate Ring of Health

items.description: A rougher version of the Refined Sandstone Block, mainly produced for quantity. Due to its outer appearance it was mainly used for foundations.
items.name: Rough Sandstone Block

items.description: These heavy boots provide excellent resistance and enable a stronger stance when facing various behemoths.
items.name: Trailblazer Boots

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Tombstone "Together Again"

items.description:
The change of tides was not kind to this creature. Perhaps it can finally rest.

Collect multiple Fell Wispwyvern Heads to craft the Trophy.
items.name: Fell Wispwyvern Trophy

items.description: A large and powerful hammer that has been corrupted by the Shroud. Good for smashing bugs!
items.name: Dreadbane

items.description: When gazing upon the crystal's surface, you feel the mirror image warp and shift into something... unsettling.
items.name: Sparkling Dark Crystal

items.description: A fresh coconut, plucked directly from a palm tree. The water inside can be drunk as is or processed into milk.
items.name: Coconut

items.description: Created with mana-potent ingredients, the Mana Potion restores a good amount of mana.
items.name: Mana Potion

items.description: Ignites a fireball projectile that erupts upon impact and deals damage in an area. Spell Charges: Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.
items.name: Fireball IV

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Bamboo Barricade I

items.description: Mint Mushroom Meat that can be used to dye all sorts of fabrics green. The name suggests a minty fresh taste, but consumption is strongly discouraged.
items.name: Mint Mushroom Meat

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Large Polished Wooden Cupboard

items.description:
A ring with glowing engravings that read: 

"May the Shroud never tear you down — Balthazar"
items.name: Alchemist's Ring

items.description: These gloves were patched together with two different fabrics. They re-create the look of "hooves".
items.name: Fluffy Mittens

items.description: A potted plant to beautify your home.
items.name: Square Plant Pot

items.description: While the Elixir buff is active, dealing damage activates the Satisfied Battle Mania buff, granting %k Health, %k Mana and %k Stamina regeneration for %k. Each additional hit refreshes the duration of that buff; however, once it runs out, the Unsatisfied Battle Mania debuff will suspend any Health, Stamina, and Mana regeneration for %k.
items.name: Gem of Battle Mania

items.description: An admiral blue-colored garment often worn by magic scholars who revere the Mother Flame. The cape attached to the shoulders falls in layers and ends in uneven trim, dancing like little spouts of fire as it moves in the wind.
items.name: Flame Arcanist Chest

items.description:
This model of the Kindlewastes shows sandy dunes and rugged cliffs, but Orindell wasn't always like this. Perhaps this scorching expanse would have looked different if water hadn't stopped flowing through its veins.

This piece is part of a greater Embervale model. To complete the miniature, all pieces must be assembled inside a frame. The pieces can be found inside the beacon dungeons and Cinder's Cradle.
items.name: Kindlewastes Miniature Piece

items.description: A bow that breaches all — flesh, scales, borders. Nothing can withstand its might.
items.name: Breaching Bow

items.description: A two-handed weapon with an unceasing swing. It holds the power to perpetually renew itself and the wielder, like the self-nourishing winds of a cyclone.
items.name: Cyclone Axe

items.description: A decorative item that can be placed in any building. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Maritime Sink

items.description: A potted plant to beautify your home.
items.name: Low Large Plant Pot

items.description: A mace that easily cleaves through foes like a pack of starving wolves.
items.name: Iron Claw Club

items.description: A Special Arrow made from steel, laced with poison, perfect for hunting. Poisoned Arrow: Enemies hit by this arrow are poisoned and additionally receive 20 damage per second for 5 seconds.
items.name: Poisoned Steel Arrow

items.description:
The light and dark facets of polished rock. Together, they remind of stone masonry, or more tragically, graveyard sculptures.

This color palette can be made with Springlands materials.
items.name: Polished Stone

items.description: A pair of dark, grey daggers adorned with a bright green gem the color of envy. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.
items.name: Grey Blades

items.description: An expertly crafted blade, balanced and sharp. Cuts through foes like a wail through the night. It bears the mark of a famous blacksmith from Pikemead's Reach.
items.name: Wailing Blade

items.description: A big burning pile that's both cozy and archaic.
items.name: Scavenger Bonfire

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Wood Wall IV

items.description: A sturdy helmet that protects the wearer from slashes, cuts, and scars.
items.name: Rogue Helmet

items.description: A seared fish cutlet that can only be prepared so well in a fish grilling cage. It is very flavorful.
items.name: Seared Fish Cutlet

items.description: A breathable tunic with ample space for storing bandages, herbs, and tissues.
items.name: Healer Tunic

items.description: Ignites an area with flames that continuously damage enemies within. It also applies a burn debuff to them. Spell Charges: Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.
items.name: Pillar Of Flames III

items.description: A decorative Item, which will provide warmth and illumination in its proximity. Provides comfort which increases the duration of the Rested Bonus.
items.name: Tall Stone Brazier

items.description:
A miniature piece that shows the Revelwood, part of Meldore. It used to be a vibrant area where the rivers flowed with wine, and the trees would shade the weary. Eventually, though, abuse of the Elixir spread, and the roots that once brought life to the Kingdom began to rot.

This piece is part of a greater Embervale model. To complete the miniature, all pieces must be assembled inside a frame. The pieces can be found inside the beacon dungeons and Cinder's Cradle.
items.name: Revelwood Miniature Piece

items.description:
Surrounded by black sand and basalt stone, the darkness closes in — but it never wins. Sometimes it's a distant star on a starry night, other times it's a friendly face. There is always something. There is always light.

This palette can be made with Cinder's Cradle materials.
items.name: A Distant Star

items.description: A decorative Item, which will provide warmth and illumination in its proximity. Provides comfort which increases the duration of the Rested Bonus.
items.name: Brazier

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Iron Bucket

items.description: Archaic power vibrates deep within this sword.
items.name: Minor Arcana

items.description: A small potted plant to beautify your home.
items.name: White Flower

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Small Polished Wooden Cabinet

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Veilwater Basin Boardwalk I

items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home. Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Ancient Ceiling Lamp

items.description: This scroll is enchanted with the power of the Shroud Meteor. It calls down a disastrous Shroud Meteor on up to five foes. Shroud Spell: This spell results in a debuff that reduces your Time in the Shroud.
items.name: Shroud Meteor Scroll

items.description: A royal blue gambeson that hides the wearer's blackened heart and devious intentions underneath. It allows you to blend into the night sky, providing the perfect camouflage for a downward strike.
items.name: Sky Specter Chest

items.description: A short-sleeved linen shirt that's topped with an orange fur cape. The cape flows down the wearer's back and ends in pieces that wave in the wind like a tail.
items.name: Fae Deer Farmer Boots

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Copper Cup

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Crude Wooden Fence III

items.description: Comfortable pants fashioned from crimson cloth. Being both durable and imposing, they can be worn for parades as well as war.
items.name: Vanguard Trousers

items.description:
A piece of the Blackmire, the long-forgotten woods. While there are no human settlements here, it is absolutely teeming with life... and mystery.

This piece is part of a greater Embervale model. To complete the miniature, all pieces must be assembled inside a frame. The pieces can be found inside the beacon dungeons and Cinder's Cradle.
items.name: Blackmire Miniature Piece

items.description: Remains of metal, which was present to witness humanity's downfall. They might turn out to be useful.
items.name: Metal Scraps

items.description:
A gruesome, skeletal Cyclops head. You can fit your entire fist through the giant eyehole!

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. It can be reassembled to form a Cyclops Skeleton on a Cyclops Trophy Base.
items.name: Cyclops Skull

items.description: A heavenly harp with silver strings, beloved by common folk and kings alike.
items.name: Harp

items.description: An adorable little Hophare. Its eyes frantically scan the environment when you pick it up, but it calms down quickly.
items.name: Baby Hophare

items.description: An extravagantly exaggerated tricorn hat that shields the caster's head from snowfall. The imposing antlers are a wearable trophy representing the wearer's spirit animal.
items.name: Thaumaturge Hat

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Scrap Platter

items.description: Padded gloves made from thick white cloth and deep blue leather arm guards. A small buckle and cyan string hold them together. The fingertips are left bare, so you can still feel the pulse of the hunt.
items.name: Frostbite Slasher Gloves

items.description: Used by a smith to melt and alloy metals.
items.name: Smelter

items.description: Faintly smells of grain, sweet summer days, and honey.
items.name: Farmer Garb

items.description: Reinforced gloves with makeshift chitin plating.
items.name: Blackguard Gloves

items.description: Conjures a flurry homing bone projectiles that hunt down enemies with crushing force. Channel Spell: Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.
items.name: Bonestorm I

items.description: What is better than one book?
items.name: Collection Of Books II

items.description: A decorative item that can be placed in any building. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Medium Ancient Table

items.description: Despite its wild mixture, it still looks appealing. It's one of those things that isn't edible, yet you still want to take a bite out of it.
items.name: Exceptional Ectoplasm

items.description:
The sand is pale and warm, the water deep and blue, the sun comes out and shines just for you. 

This palette can be made with Cinder's Cradle materials.
items.name: Sun & Shore

items.description: A dense chunk of nickel and iron. The slow cooling over millions of years formed its crystal bands — the Widmanstätten structure.
items.name: Iron Meteorite

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Ornamented Vase II

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Simple Tropical Wood Fence with Ropes I

items.description: A small potted plant to beautify your home.
items.name: Red Flower

items.description: A glistening silver metal that has a wide range of applications.
items.name: Iron Bars

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Simple Coffin Lid

items.description: Heavy gauntlets that aim to protect your hands in combat. You can swing your blade fearlessly with these.
items.name: Greatsword Gauntlets

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Carved Tropical Wood Fence Pole

items.description: These boots are ideal for stalking prey.
items.name: Hunter Boots

items.description: A potted plant to beautify your home.
items.name: Yellow Flower

items.description: A soaked boot, damaged through years of water exposure. Perhaps the fur on it could be useful.
items.name: Wet Boot

items.description: This block has an aesthetic that is exclusive to the Blackmire. Only this biome's unique flora and humidity can make Ancient stones weather like this.
items.name: Weathered Ancient Stone Block

items.description: Flour that can be created by grinding Wheat Grains to dust.
items.name: Flour

items.description: A rare and valuable metal thanks to its thermal conductivity. It's often used to create things that require a lot of heat.
items.name: Copper Bars

items.description: A large crystal with a threatening aura.
items.name: Large Dark Crystal

items.description: Use this showcase to reassemble the Queen <lorename>Pikemead</lorename> statue.
items.name: Pikemead Statue Showcase

items.description: Damaging an enemy puts a mark on them for %k. Marked enemies spawn a soul phial on death that can be destroyed to heal you and your allies for %k Health points in a 5m radius and also counts as an enemy kill for other effects.
items.name: Gem of Soul Reaping

items.description: Elegant boots with blue accents. They exude glamour and grace.
items.name: Mystic Boots

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Drak Stone Totem III

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Big Elegant Sofa

items.description: This gate can be lowered or raised to control the water flow around it. It's perfect for gardeners who want an efficient way to water their plants!
items.name: Irrigation Gate Large

items.description: A knight's boots. They've seen much peril and anguish.
items.name: Knight Boots

items.description:
A small part of a shattered Flame mosaic. Perhaps you can piece it together if you find all the shards!

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. The full collection includes 8 pieces. They can be reassembled into a mosaic inside a Flame Mosaic Frame. The Frame must be placed on the ground.
items.name: Flame Mosaic Piece IV

items.description: What is better than one book?
items.name: Collection Of Books III

items.description: A pair of charcoal black, loosely fitted pants. The larger silhouette stems from the extensive wool padding inside.
items.name: Mountain's Shadow Trousers

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Huge Ancient Door

items.description: A prideful set of daggers. They foretell a path through the galaxy, enabling the wielder to rise and slash their mark into a star-dotted sky. 3 golden rings mark the handle's beginning and end. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.
items.name: Ascendant Daggers

items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil.
items.name: Oak Tree Seedling

items.description: A block crafted from Luminous Growth material that glows in the dark. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.
items.name: Blue Luminescent Block

items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home. Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Orange Pendant Light II

items.description: A Roof Tiles Block is needed to build shingle roofs, commonly seen in construction.
items.name: Roof Tiles Block

items.description: An expertly crafted blade, balanced and sharp. Cuts through foes like a wail through the night. It bears the mark of a famous blacksmith from Pikemead's Reach.
items.name: Wailing Blade

items.description: An ancient potted plant. This one can be displayed in the Cultivation Rack.
items.name: Small Prickle Pearl Plant Pot

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Vat I

items.name: Rising Fighter Gloves

A radiant whirl of energy that is needed to insert gems into weaponry. 

While initially used by the Ancients, it was claimed by the Fell to fuel their brood until you freed it from its newly organic prison.
items.name: Archaic Essence VI

items.description: This liquid was created by crushing ectoplasm shards and gathering the resulting goo. It's been filtered and is technically sterile.
items.name: Greater Ectoplasm

items.description: Her whip still haunts you in your dreams so you chose to hang her head instead.
items.name: Scavenger Tyrant Trophy

items.description: A formidable shield that can keep you and your allies safe.
items.name: Valiant Shield

items.description: Used to bind things together, String is an extremely important item.

items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
items.name: Shiitake Seedling

items.description: Historic pants, formerly the centerpiece of ceremonial warlock clothing.
items.name: Warlock Pants

items.description: The Fell Critter Queen's antennas are stiff with age, and her curved, fang-like mandibles still frame her mouth. You don't feel terror when looking at them now; they seem almost delicate to your touch.
items.name: Fell Critter Queen Trophy

items.description: "A new and improved version of the Constructeer V1.0! This model is lighter, faster, more precise, and all-around better! See the delicate lines I've added to the sides? They swing as if bound by gravitational pull — a reminder that time never stands still, and neither should we! Let's move forward into a new era together!" - Artificer Constantio
items.name: Constantio's Constructeer, V2.0

items.description: A basic fishing rod made out of the simplest ingredients. Don't pull too hard, or it might break. It also doesn't lay particularly well in the hand, so long fights are not possible with it.

items.description: This ring will increase your health and healing rate.
items.name: Greater Ring of Health

items.description: The Bloomheart Fruit takes it's time to ripen, but when it's ready something so juicy and sweet awaits you. It's worth the patience.
items.name: Bloomheart Fruit

items.description:
A model of the Springlands, the place where everything began. Green rolling hills, the smell of honey in the air, and clear skies above — but life couldn't stay this peaceful. Not for a Flameborn, anyway.

This piece is part of a greater Embervale model. To complete the miniature, all pieces must be assembled inside a frame. The pieces can be found inside the beacon dungeons and Cinder's Cradle.
items.name: Springlands Miniature Piece

items.description: An ancestral weapon from the proud family line of the Galeforths, last held by Virgil Galeforth. He famously said: "If you want this weapon, you'll have to pry it from my cold, dead hands".

items.description: An axe made for cutting down trees. Slightly less effective for fighting off wolves.
items.name: Fenrig's Axe

items.description: The best way to elevate your outfit is by extensively adding belts and straps to an inflationary degree, or so they say. A golden sigil on the chest signals your dedication to the Flame.
items.name: Flame Pact Vest

items.description: These boots provide resistance and grip when stuck in a fierce snowstorm.

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.description: A pair of warm pants, tinged in a deep blue. It provides ample protection from the elements.

A silver helmet that increases your maximum oxygen while diving.

Its delicate engraved lines imitate the flow of water, and the viewport is segmented like a clam's shell.

items.description: A sequence of words is etched along the handle. They feel vaguely familiar to you. I fly so high, I may never come down I dance on the sun, whole body ablaze My cup's always full, I'd drink till I drown In liquid light and limerence, until I feel dazed Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

items.description: A pickaxe forged from basalt stone and celestium. The most durable of its kind.

This collectible is found in the Revelwood.

items.description: The natural resource needed to create Iron Bars, an important material for every adventurer on the way to the top.

Collect multiple Hollow Cyclops Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

items.description: An axe made for cutting down trees. Slightly less effective for fighting off wolves.

White like freshly fallen snow, somewhere on the edge of the world.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.

Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.

Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

items.description:
Hard to believe there is an even better concoction.

This one instantly restores a massive amount of health.
items.name: Ultimate Health Potion

You have slain the Fell Critter Queen so many times that her golden trophy can embellish your walls. One could say you have earned the right to take her place and be the new Queen. But there was nobody left to rule.

You checked twice for a pulse, just to make sure it's dead. Skeletons normally don't have one, and this one is covered in bronze... You're probably in the clear.

Collect multiple Hollow Wispwyvern Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

items.description: A barrel that will store rainwater.

items.description: A mask that conceals the face, framing it with faintly printed cloth ribbons that fly in the wind. It may cover the eyes, but the devilish horns betray the wearer's aching for chaos nonetheless.

items.name: Golden Bulwark Chestplate

items.name: Guardian Boots

The woman that lived in the house before had many dogs, and her favorite was called "Pompom". Maybe this dog is one of its descendants!
items.name: Pompom Jr.

Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

items.name: Exclusive Hollow Gloves

Every river or peak, ruin and castle, fight and fable was crafted with their support, and in their honor. Our world would not exist without them. The last words on the final page simply read "Thank you for everything."

items.description: Gray pants which have been refined with expertly crafted metal parts.

items.description: Piscine Ivory, often called the ivory of the sea, ground into a bright powder. Renowned for its strength and resilience, it can even serve as a component in metal alloys, lending them exceptional robustness.

items.description: Firing an arrow with these gloves is effortless, creating a silky smooth stream of movement for the wearer.
items.name: Deerstalker Gloves

items.description: Scarlet gloves that remind you of all the blood you've shed. Will the battle ever end? You do not know for sure, but today, we shall not dwell on it — for today is for the living.

items.description: Used to build thatched roofs. A basic and reliable solution to protect yourself from the elements.

The golden Direwolf does not show that it was victorious — it shows that you were.

That's probably for the best. Mothers have enough headaches already.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.

The brown fluid emits a violet vapor and is used for many powerful alchemical purposes.

items.description: This bow's natural resistance to fire makes it perfect for firing volleys of flaming arrows.
items.name: Tarred Bow

items.description: Grants a %k base chance to spawn a health orb when defeating an enemy. Collecting a health orb grants %k additional cutting damage to attacks and increases the chance for health orbs by %k for %k.
items.name: Gem of Bloodlust

items.description: This trap door might open unexpectedly beneath your feet. Watch your step!
items.name: Trapdoor Wood 4m

items.description: An organic growth that glows brightly in the deep, dark waters.
items.name: Underwater Luminous Growth

items.description: A malicious staff that effortlessly intertwines the strings of fate with the Shroud. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.
items.name: Shroud Weaver

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Ancient Centrifuge

items.description: A hearty, creamy soup made with tender chunks of fish and fresh vegetables.
items.name: Fish Chowder

items.description: A crude dagger, previously used by a Vukah in a bloody ritual. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.
items.name: Sacrificial Vukah Dagger

items.description: A metal used to create bronze. It can be found in the Nomad Highlands.
items.name: Tin Bars

items.description: Hitting an enemy applies a mark that can stack up to 5 times. Marked enemies will emit an explosion when no new stack of mark has been added for %k or if the enemy dies. The explosion deals %k Shroud damage in a 1m radius. Each stack adds 0,5m and %k of the base damage to the explosion.
items.name: Gem of Corruption

items.description: A construction hammer used by the Ancients to create their multi-purpose constructs. It was created to be incredibly lightweight to reduce the breaks workers would initiate from tired arms.
items.name: Constantio's Constructeer, V1.0

items.description:
A little feeding bowl for your Dog.

It will feed your animals when filled with the corresponding food.
items.name: Dog Bowl

items.description: A lonely soul, brought low by the Shroud — and set free by your blade.
items.name: Fell Dragon Youngling Trophy

items.description: Fireworks to celebrate your victories!
items.name: Fireworks

items.description:
The severed, golden head, forever frozen in time, invites you to look within. To reach this moment, you had to perfect your fighting strategy. Well done.

Collect multiple Fell Striker Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.
items.name: Gold Fell Striker Trophy

items.description: The needles of this spiked club can tenderize countless meat bags to mush.
items.name: Fleshgrinder

items.description: A little archaic, but better than cloth.
items.name: Fur Trousers

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Boreal Wood Table

items.description: Pierce your foes through the heart — using your horns isn’t necessary.
items.name: Skull Stalker Helmet

items.description: Releases an aimed mending ray that continuously heals allies within. Channel Spell: Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.
items.name: Heal Beam

items.description: Protects the fingers from traps and cuts. A rogue's best friend!
items.name: Rogue Gloves

items.description: A blade that's cold to the touch. It weighs heavily on the mind.
items.name: Hailscourge

items.description: An adorable Capybara. It's entirely unbothered while in your arms. The bristles can be used in crafting.
items.name: Capybara

items.description: A display to showcase weapons or shields.
items.name: Staff Wall Mount

items.description: A versatile one-handed axe. Frequently used to split the skulls of enemies.
items.name: Hatchet

items.description: An expertly crafted lute, originally owned by Chester Loft of The Honeydews — the most daring and lucky of the members. Fans also dubbed him "The Lucky Lute". Despite his adventurous tastes, his good fortune always kept him and his lute out of trouble, so the quality and craftsmanship of the instrument are well preserved.
items.name: Ornate Lute

items.description:
A showcase that holds pieces of a Drak themed relief.
Collect all pieces to complete this showcase and unlock special trophy recipes.
items.name: Drak Relief Showcase

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Golden Vase Of The Ancients III

items.description: Empties your stomach immediately and clears all active food buffs. Sadly not effective against food poisoning.
items.name: Puke Potion

items.description: Gloves made from rotting, undead matter. They claw at their wearer's upper arms as if to grow upwards.
items.name: Omen Gloves

items.description: The adventuring Bard, Valory, carves instruments and shares exciting tales from her travels through Embervale.
items.name: Valory

items.description: Grows entangling roots in an area that apply a debuff to enemies which prevents them from moving for a short duration. Rooted enemies are still able to perform attacks and bigger ones are slowed instead of rooted. Spell Charges: Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.
items.name: Entangle II

items.description: Runes are mystical artifacts that attract and store magical energy from the environment. Craftspeople and their assistants can use runes to enhance your weapons, shields, armors and rings, which provides powerful bonuses and effects. Salvage weapons, shields, armors and rings to recover runes, allowing you to reuse them and customize your arsenal.
items.name: Runes

items.description: Use these gloves to seal away your combatons' life force, binding them to life at your behest. Should they fall, nevertheless, then they will rise from the ashes with a flick of your wrist.
items.name: Lifelock Gloves

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Large Salon Mirror

items.description:
Cabbage, thyme, and moonstone — greens that run deep, blues that carry something ancient.

This palette can be made with Cinder's Cradle materials.
items.name: Ancient Greenery

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Big Hollow's Eve Pumpkin III

items.description: A long furry coat, often worn by the citizens of the Albaneve Summits. It's very cozy.
items.name: Winterly Chest

items.description: Throw this mystical vessel to temporarily summon a skull companion.
items.name: Skull Summoning Vessel II

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Supply Sacks III

items.description: A healthy mix of vegetables. When eaten with care, it will fill both your stomach and heart.
items.name: Stir-Fried Vegetables

items.description: Sturdy gloves that protect the hands while exploring. The red markings on them represent bravery.
items.name: Adventurer Gloves

items.description: Unyielding and unbroken, this staff resembles the realm's last bastion of hope. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.
items.name: Hopeful Glimmer

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Palm Leaf Basket

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Room Divider "Fish"

items.description: It's said that the original owner of this helmet wore it to hide his many facial scars. Whether this is true is uncertain.
items.name: Gloom Monarch Helmet

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Graveyard Fence Pole

items.description: Modified to increase the mana control, this wand shoots ice projectiles with a bit more force. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.
items.name: Apprentice Wand

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Boreal Wood Garden Fence Door

items.description: Copper-plated gloves that protect the wearer's tender hands during a brawl.
items.name: Tank Gloves

items.description: A strong bow that frames each shot between two serpents' maws. Let your arrows strike with the calculated savagery of a viper in waiting!
items.name: Bow Of The Serpent

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Rustic Window Frame I

items.description: Cloven, finely segmented boots. Their shape is reminiscent of Fae Deer hooves.
items.name: Efflorescent Hope Boots

items.description: Warm and padded hunting pants that will retain your body heat during cold, starless nights.
items.name: Deerstalker Trousers

items.description: This drain will remove any water above it. Can be placed on the wall.
items.name: Stone Wall Drain

items.description:
A color palette that makes you feel like a scholar, wandering through wisteria-laden archways to take samples of the flora.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.
items.name: Mysterious Mauve

items.description: A special piece of cloth was added to this assassin hood to hide the wearer's face and their most likely daunting smile.
items.name: Assassin Hood

items.description: This helmet lets you portray a particularly patient and calculating gaze.
items.name: Serpent Warrior Helmet

items.description: A refined chest piece that lets you fade into the dark and strike from the shadows.
items.name: Assassin Chest

items.description: A light and swift sword of beautiful color. It dulls quickly, though.
items.name: Bronze Sword

items.description: Nobody really knows what it is. They just call it the "Spice". It makes food much more delicious though, so it is highly sought after!
items.name: Spice

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Small Palm Wood Cabinet

items.description: Two leather straps, locked in place with enchanted ectoplasm crystals, seal away this tome's whispers. Despite being ancient, the fine aquamarine binding shows no signs of age or decay.
items.name: Bound Tome

items.description: Somewhere in the kingdom of Orindell, naked feet dance upon hot marble floors. The pain is temporary, but the memory will last. Music Sheet: Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.
items.name: Child Of The Lyre

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Bamboo Boardwalk II

items.description: Simple but nourishing. Boosts Health and Stamina Regeneration.
items.name: Boiled Eggs

items.description: The decorative orbs attached to the bow's body light up and darken in sync. Always together, chained to an otherworldly rhythm, an ebb and flow from beyond.
items.name: Bow Of The Twin Moons

items.description: Delicate fabric with intricate details, ever-shifting with the angle of the sun. Worn by the Scholars who chased knowledge across these lands.
items.name: Scholar of the Young Flame Pants

items.description: Summons a totem that launches icy projectiles at enemies, applying a slow debuff to them. Maximum amount of summoned totems is 1 by default which can be increased via skills. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.
items.name: Eternal Ice Totem I

items.description: The blade near the handle is segmented into three shapes, which form an upside-down heart when viewed as a whole. It carries a vermilion gemstone inside that burns bright as a pyre.
items.name: Pyreheart Blade

items.description: Despair, hatred, loneliness... it grasps at anything to fill the void and leaves nothing but dust.
items.name: Fell Monstrosity Head

items.description: This pair of pants has significant padding on the inside, allowing you to travel for longer periods in frost-ridden lands. Traditionally, hides from the wearer's spirit animal are used to create the padding, but wool will do in a pinch.
items.name: Thaumaturge Pants

items.description: A wand that harnesses the power of the eclipse. It functions best when the sun is fully submerged in darkness, and only a faint rim of light shines through. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Ethereal Duplication: The wand's unique magic grants it a 30% chance to spontaneously create an additional projectile. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.
items.name: Darya's Wand

items.description: Conjures an icy projectile that deals damage in an area and applies a slow debuff. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.
items.name: Eternal Ice Bolt IV

items.description: This tool can only be used inside the building area around a Flame Altar. It can help you to quickly build your desired base with pre-defined structures.
items.name: Disc 3m

items.description: The <npc>Carpenter</npc> Cade Hawthorn can craft anything with wood.
items.name: Cade Hawthorn

items.description:
A pair of rotting pants, held together by stabilizing chitin shells.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.
items.name: Blackguard Trousers

items.description: Excellent tools to scout with — especially due to their grip and padding.
items.name: Scout Gloves

items.description: A crude dagger, previously used by a Vukah in a bloody ritual. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.
items.name: Sacrificial Vukah Dagger

items.description:
This well is deep enough to tap into even the most hidden water reservoirs. 

It was improved and can reach the groundwater quicker.
items.name: Improved Water Well

items.description: There are only a few ways to flee a promise you don't intend to keep. At least one of them involves murder. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.
items.name: Oath Breaker

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Crude Wooden Jug

items.description: A potent staff capable of guiding those who would otherwise be without protection. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.
items.name: Shepherd's Staff

items.description: A wig head that unlocks more haircuts once picked up. It can also be placed in your base as decoration.
items.name: Barber's Favorite Wig Head

items.description:
Frozen, enshrouded liquid that's cold to the touch.

Commonly found in the Shroud of the Albaneve Summits biome.

It's unusable by itself, but can be processed into different materials in crafting.
items.name: Enshrouded Ice

items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
items.name: Yucca Palm Seedling

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Carved Limestone Vase I

items.description: Reinforced with Metal Scraps for better protection.
items.name: Fur Chest

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Golden Room Divider

items.description: A strong bow that frames each shot between two serpents' maws. Let your arrows strike with the calculated savagery of a viper in waiting!
items.name: Bow Of The Serpent

items.description: Music that evokes flaming rays of sunlight, and the burning soles of a 1000-mile walk. Music Sheet: Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.
items.name: Mirage

items.description: A hammer adorned with an ancient petrified tusk. Tusks and teeth were used by the Vukah for mystical purposes.
items.name: Soothsayer

items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home. Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Crypt Candle

items.description:
A small part of a shattered Flame mosaic. Perhaps you can piece it together if you find all the shards!

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. The full collection includes 8 pieces. They can be reassembled into a mosaic inside a Flame Mosaic Frame. The Frame must be placed on the ground.
items.name: Flame Mosaic Piece V

items.description: Fine sand that's been infused with Shroud spores. Commonly found in the Kindlewastes biome.
items.name: Shroud Sand

items.description: This axe is eerily precise. The hair on your arms stands up as you wield it.
items.name: Hair Splitter

items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
items.name: Berry Bush Seedling

items.description: Fashioned from a piece of fishing net and seaborn trinkets. It keeps the hair out of your face while you dive.
items.name: Siren Seeker Headband

items.description:
Nutritious Cat food for tame pets.

It must be placed inside the appropriate feeder.
items.name: Cat Food

items.description:
This cat is as dark as the midnight sky and its charming demands for attention never go unanswered. It purrs loudly whenever you are near! 

The Scavengers that kept this cat were unsure whether to call it "Captain" or "Whiskers".
items.name: Captain Whiskers

items.description: A brightly burning visage graces this helmet, setting both the battlefield and hearts alike ablaze.
items.name: Radiant Paladin Helmet

items.description: A block made from pale ribs and cranial bone. Its ivory guise decorates tombs and temples alike. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.
items.name: Bone Block

items.description:
Sometimes, when the tropical winds of the Veilwater Basin roll towards the cold air of the mountains, a thundersnow is born. 
The snowfall softens its roars, but it leaves traces in the freshly cracked surfaces of frozen ponds.
items.name: Ring of Thundersnow

items.description: Daggers with many edges and sharp hooks. They can be whipped out in the blink of an eye to parry incoming attacks, thus defending your honor. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.
items.name: Proud Daggers

items.description: Woodland boots made of carefully layered leather straps.
items.name: Marksman Boots

items.description: This mushroom skewer will strengthen not only your flesh but also your mind. Grilled over a fire, it will raise your maximum health, increase your magic damage, and accelerate your mana regeneration.
items.name: Raw Meat and Azure Russula Skewer

items.description: The best stories start small. For example with a stone.
items.name: Revelwood Stone

items.description: A Shroud-tainted wand which radiates darkness. You feel that using it will widen a hidden void beneath Embervale, slowly growing in obscurity, swallowing all around... but perhaps using it once or twice won't hurt? Shroud Imbued: This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Ethereal Duplication: The wand's unique magic grants it a 30% chance to spontaneously create an additional projectile. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.
items.name: Voidcaller

items.description: A forgotten sword from long-gone days. Commonly found among the ashes of Embervale.
items.name: Rusty Short Sword

items.description: Summons rescued survivors into your bases around a Flame Altar.
items.name: Summoning Staff

items.description: A local delicacy with a creamy texture and rich taste. It fills the belly and heals the soul, especially when the north winds are howling outside.
items.name: Creamy Mushroom Spaetzle

items.description:
Leather pants with noticeable grain that morphs into fine fungal tendrils.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.
items.name: Plaguebringer Trousers

items.description: A music sheet that contains a thought-provoking tune. Snow falls ever so slowly when pondering the past. Music Sheet: Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.
items.name: Lonely At The Top

items.description: Sturdy gloves, dark as the midnight sky. They've been adorned with animal horns that were gathered during the hunt.
items.name: Trailblazer Gloves

items.description: A unique building block for roads. It creates paths with harmonious circle patterns.
items.name: Ancient Road Block

items.description: These gloves are a bit stiff and barely functional. The most important thing is that they look impressive to peasants. You won't need to do manual labor, anyway.
items.name: Royal Gloves

items.description: A hood that provides additional protection from the sun, allowing you to focus your gaze undisturbed.
items.name: Ranger Hood

items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home. Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Scrap Standing Torch

items.description: A helmet which protects your sensitive cranial bone from harm while riding into battle.
items.name: Warlock Helmet

items.description: A mannequin that can be dressed in armor or vanity items.
items.name: Mannequin "Victory"

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Veilwater Basin Boardwalk II

items.description: An adult Fae Deer. It loves head pats!
items.name: Fae Deer

items.description: Instantly restores a lot of health, and continuously heals for 10 seconds.
items.name: Revitalizing Health Potion +

items.description: A switch button combined with a light. Pushing the button switches the state between ON and OFF. A glowing light indicates the ON state.
items.name: Switch Button

items.description: A glimmering ring, plucked from the remains of someone who got more than they bargained for.
items.name: Ring of Rapacity

items.description: Opens doors of great importance.
items.name: Gold Key

items.description: Adventurers who wear these fearsome boots should not be messed with.
items.name: Rogue Boots

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Wall Tapestry III

items.description: Releases a mending ray that automatically seeks nearby allies. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.
items.name: Eternal Chain Heal I

items.description: These gauntlets shield your arms as you chase through the undergrowth, striking foes from afar.
items.name: Quetzal Hunter Gloves

items.description: The leather on this nature-bound armor piece was layered to resemble the leaves of a withering forest.
items.name: Marksman Vest

items.description: Instead of exploiting the ruins of forgotten times, you vow to protect them — to uphold their sanctity for reverence not only today, but tomorrow.
items.name: Temple Keeper's Bow

items.description: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.
items.name: Fenrig Mills, Jr.

items.description: Conjures a charged wisp that trails you for a short duration. It hurls shock projectiles at enemies that also deal Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.
items.name: Eternal Shock Wisp II

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Room Divider "Flower"

items.description: A simple magical staff made from calcified bone. Rudimentary, but effective. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.
items.name: Staff

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Wall Banner

items.description: A medium potted plant to beautify your home.
items.name: Yellow Flower

items.description:
A gland that's seemingly dripping with poison. Don't think about it too much, or the visual will haunt your dreams.

Found on poison-spitting spiders and can be used in crafting to produce an antidote to Hemotoxin.
items.name: Spider Gland

items.description:
The most different experiences gathered and described on a scroll.

Gain a small amount of experience upon absorption of the content.
items.name: Experience Scroll

items.description: These pants are just as short as a foe’s lifespan in your presence.
items.name: Sunpiercer Pants

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Standing Banner of the Ancients I

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Crude Wooden Fence IV

items.description:
This bottom-dwelling fish is known for its long whiskers, which it uses to sense movement and food in the water. Apparently, it sensed your bait, too.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.
items.name: Whiskerfin

items.description: A decorative Item, which will provide warmth and illumination in its proximity. Provides comfort which increases the duration of the Rested Bonus.
items.name: Small Throne Room Brazier

items.description: Seeing this helmet makes others feel safe and secure.
items.name: Guardian Helmet

items.description: A colorful and flashy hat, often worn by poets, minstrels, or traders of luxurious goods.
items.name: Minstrel Hat

items.description: The Drak decorate their settlements with such trophies. It's impressive that they even washed off the blood — they surely reuse it for other purposes...
items.name: Skull Trophy III

items.description: Sodden boots that strode through the knee-high snow of Albaneve Summits under foreboding northern lights. After marching through countless midnight hours, Lord <lorename>Vorgoth</lorename> finally reached the gates of <location><lorename>Pikemead</lorename>'s Reach</location>, weapon raised high.
items.name: Guard of the North Boots

items.description: You can't read sacred scrolls if you can't see, but true understanding comes from within, anyway.
items.name: Sage Headwrap

items.description: Bark from the giant trees in the Blackmire. It feels rough but could look quite cozy.
items.name: Blackmire Bark

items.description: A medium potted plant to beautify your home.
items.name: Fern

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Big Hollow's Eve Pumpkin I

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Jezmina's War Banner II

items.description: A delicate ring with the symbol of the Gemini — quivering with hatred in the moonlight.
items.name: Gemini Ring

items.description: Nothing is more suitable for a long prowl than this set of pants.
items.name: Hunter Trousers

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: "Still Life"

items.description: Even in death, the Queen unites those who seek protection behind her shield. Parry You can block when equipped with any Melee weapon, Ward, or Shield. A well-timed block will parry the attack and fill up the enemy's Stun Bar. Wait to see a flash on the enemy or projectile to perform a parry.
items.name: Pikemead's Bulwark

items.description:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.
items.name: Dark Red Hair

items.description: Lord Vorgoth's once-trusted blade was discarded before the war and replaced by a weapon more befitting vile acts. It still clings to a semblance of sanity and light, shining brightly in the dark like the North Star.
items.name: Guard Of The North Sword

items.description: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.
items.name: Marianne Reed

items.description: Headgear for herbalists. Healing others is surprisingly hard when you can't actually see them.
items.name: Herbalist Headwrap

items.description: Finely ground obsidian powder. It can more easily be alchemized in this form.
items.name: Obsidian Dust

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Round Polished Window Frame

items.description: Silent pants to tread quietly.
items.name: Scout Pants

items.description: Decorative bells are especially suitable for the yearfall.
items.name: Decorative Bells I

items.description: A display to showcase weapons or shields.
items.name: One-Handed Melee Weapon Rack

items.description: An almost guaranteed catch for common fish!
items.name: Common Fishing Bait

items.description: An arrow made from bone. The force of this arrow allows it to pierce hit targets to harm multiple foes.
items.name: Bone Arrow

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Small Crypt Sideboard

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Boreal Wood Garden Fence Pole

items.description: Summons a Hollow Wretch ally that attacks enemies. Maximum amount of summoned Hollow allies is 1 by default which can be increased via skills. Spell Charges: Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.
items.name: Hollow Wretch I

items.description: The exposed wooden beams create a beautiful contrast to the rough surface, creating a feeling of warmth.
items.name: Half-timbered Shell Limestone Block

items.description:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.
items.name: Yellow Eyes

items.description: A decorative item that can be placed in any building. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Granite Stone Bathtub

items.description: A staff that absorbs energy from the soil. It's brimming with potential. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.
items.name: Undergrowth Staff

items.description: A belted chest armor piece that's marked by thick, linear grooves and ridges that stretch towards the sun. It is adorned with violet trim that elevates the construction and creates a pleasing color palette reminiscent of the hues of the Mother Flame.
items.name: Crestflame Chest

items.description: The dusty remains of building materials.
items.name: Rubble

items.description: An ancient ring that gives you stamina.
items.name: Lesser Ring of Stamina

items.description: Shiny red bricks that are crafted by hardening Lump of Clay under a heat even a Flameborn has issues with.
items.name: Fired Bricks

items.description: These spiky daggers were often worn by soldiers around their belts during parades as a show of force. Sometimes, children are gifted a simpler version as their first weapon. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.
items.name: Parade Daggers

I wanted to paint the Flameborn directly, but I cannot begin to fathom what they will look like. Maybe I will get to meet them one day... then, I'll paint them a proper portrait! Until then, I hope you keep this painting safe, friends. - J
