items.description: A decoratively wrapped present box.
items.name: Violet Decorative Box

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Small Bamboo Baordwalk

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Scrap Pot III

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Vase Of The Ancients III

items.description: Offers a small prayer to the Flame, that increases your magic damage and the maximum time in the Shroud for a short duration.
items.name: Prayer of the Flame Scroll

items.description: A shiny material with an interesting texture. Any garment made with this will appear very fashionable.
items.name: Water Reptile Leather

items.description: A club that was bathed in divine waters, thus acquiring a blessing of protection. Turns out blessings are less effective than cold, hard steel when caught in an ambush.
items.name: Blessed Club

items.description: The standard and favored building block among the Ancients.
items.name: Ancient Stone Block

items.description: Fireworks to celebrate your victories!
items.name: Fireworks

items.description: A decorative item that can be placed in any building. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Bamboo Bedside Table

items.description: A resilient herb, growing in the harsh Kindlewastes climate. Spiritualists were known to use it for mystical purposes.
items.name: Grapple Plant

items.description: With this chest piece, you can cut through the woods with ease, remaining undetected as you prepare your next strike.
items.name: Bloodfeather Chest

items.description: Daggers that were bathed in sunlight during forging. Their spiked edge can cause a lot of damage! Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.
items.name: Lightforged Daggers

items.description: A solid gold block from the Ancients, frequently used to adorn structures with decorative trim.
items.name: Ancient Gold Block

items.description: A machine that's used to roast coffee beans. Necessary to make coffee.
items.name: Coffee Drum Roaster

items.description: A head piece to keep your skull safe when diving into battle.
items.name: Rising Fighter Helmet

items.description: A decorative item that can be placed in any building. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Stone Shower

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Small Polished Wooden Cupboard

items.description: Fool others looking for hidden passages in your base with this fake secret door.
items.name: Carved Secret Bookshelf Door

items.description: Hide passages in your base behind this secret door.
items.name: Secret Granite Door

items.description: A medium potted plant to beautify your home.
items.name: Wolfsbane Plant

items.description: A colorful dish of rice, beans, and fresh vegetables. As nourishing as it is beautiful.
items.name: Aurora Bean Rice

items.description: A staff that awakes slumbering anger inside the wielder. The protruding amethyst spikes help to channel the emotion towards enemies. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.
items.name: Staff of the Taurus

items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home. Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Throne Room Wall Lamp

items.description: Warm and padded hunting pants that will retain your body heat during cold, starless nights.
items.name: Deerstalker Trousers

items.description: A mix of soil, rock, and sediment. Drainage This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.
items.name: Albaneve Summits Dirt

items.description: A mana potion with higher concentration, instantly restoring a great amount of mana upon use.
items.name: Greater Mana Potion

items.description: Spawner
items.name: Spawner

items.description:
Rich in protein and delicious, but only a small snack.

Increases health of the user by a small margin.
items.name: Grilled Lean Meat

items.description: An arrow made from bone. The force of this arrow allows it to pierce hit targets to harm multiple foes.
items.name: Giant Bone Arrow I

items.description: These fireworks were brought to you by the wonders of alchemy!
items.name: Purple Rocket

items.description: Adorned with a crystal and gold trim, these gloves give you a firm grip on your daggers — ideal for strikes from behind.
items.name: Bloodfeather Gloves

items.description: A glistening green blade, perfectly representing the aesthetics of the year of the serpent.
items.name: Sword Of The Serpent

items.description:
A luminous blend of crystal blues and soft turquoise hues captures the shimmering depths of clear waters. Calm yet vibrant, this palette radiates the freshness and clarity of aquamarine crystals, exuding a quiet elegance.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.
items.name: Aquamarine Dreams

items.description: Use these gloves to seal away your combatons' life force, binding them to life at your behest. Should they fall, nevertheless, then they will rise from the ashes with a flick of your wrist.
items.name: Lifelock Gloves

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: High Iron Window Frame II

items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home. Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Pendant Ceiling Lantern

items.description: Tied dark leather boots with quilted fabric sections. They reach up to the wearer's knees, protecting the shins from deep snow.
items.name: Pearlfrost Mentor Boots

items.description: This spinning machine can refine wool and is more effective at producing string and linen.
items.name: Spinning Machine

items.description: A massive, razor-sharp talon. Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.
items.name: Enshrouded Vulture Talon

items.description: Use this showcase to reassemble the Queen <lorename>Pikemead</lorename> statue.
items.name: Pikemead Statue Showcase

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Simple Tropical Wood Fence with Ropes II

items.description: A wand that harnesses the power of the eclipse. It functions best when the sun is fully submerged in darkness, and only a faint rim of light shines through. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Ethereal Duplication: The wand's unique magic grants it a 30% chance to spontaneously create an additional projectile. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.
items.name: Darya's Wand

items.description:
A highly effective bandage with thyme extract.

This item heals 80% health over 10 seconds if applied to a wound and clears any poison effect.

Receiving any damage interrupts the healing effect.
items.name: Ultimate Bandage

items.description: Opens a locked chest.
items.name: Bronze Key

items.description: The mesosiderite consists of a rough mix of metal and stone. They likely resulted from a crash between two asteroids.
items.name: Large Mesosiderite

items.description: A metal plate shield that was twisted and shaped in a Shroudstorm. It seems to be almost indestructible.
items.name: Stormshield

items.description: This club can take on hordes of enemies, never wavering.
items.name: Club of Defiance

items.description:
These warm oranges evoke the smell of daylilies, the warmth of a hearthfire, and the vision of sharing a sunrise with the one you love.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.
items.name: Daylilies For Emily

items.description:
The dark brown and green give the appearance of an overgrown garden or a mystical clearing.

This color palette can be made with Nomad Highlands materials.
items.name: Mossy Stone

items.description: When a drakling hatches from its shell, its lowered, elongated body appears almost snake-like. However, they soon adapt an upright posture and bare their teeth — this process is represented through the design of this mace.
items.name: Freshblood Mace

items.description: A totem's grimace decorates this wand, watching your every move... sometimes, it empowers your magic. Sometimes, you feel it waiting for your downfall. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.
items.name: Totem Wand

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Wooden Palisade I

items.description: A potted plant to beautify your home.
items.name: Empty Cymbidium Pot

items.description:
A dance of cerulean and powder blue.

This color palette can be made with Revelwood materials.
items.name: Blue Goblet

items.description: Comfortable cloth pants that protect one from scratches and burns. They feel well-insulated.
items.name: Artificer's Pants

items.description: The wielder's energy melts inside the wand's empty husk and reforms to shoot forth a boundless stream of elemental energy. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.
items.name: Coalescent Wand

items.description: A sturdy material that was woven out of linen. It revolutionized the clothing industry due to its flexibility and durability. It looks better as well.
items.name: Fabric

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Clay Pot II

items.description: A glowing block casting a yellow light that's visible across vast distances. The Ancients are believed to have used it for navigation and signaling — though whatever network it was part of has long since fallen silent.
items.name: Ancient Beacon Block

items.description: An axe to end any battle — quickly.
items.name: Lumenshade Axe

items.description: A pair of pants with leather greaves. They don't rustle while moving and muffle every little sound while sneaking around.
items.name: Wolf's Fang Trousers

items.description: All the forgotten knowledge of the world will be at your fingertips with these highly sought-after gloves.
items.name: Elder Gloves

items.description:
A radiant whirl of energy that is needed to insert gems into weaponry. 

While initially used by the Ancients, it was claimed by the Fell to fuel their brood until you freed it from its newly organic prison.
items.name: Archaic Essence VII

items.description: These daggers mark the next stage for young Drak after training with bamboo sticks. Their compact size makes them easy to wield even from an early age. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.
items.name: Drakling Daggers

items.description: A hood fashioned from the scalp of a white wolf. The fangs at the front are still attached.
items.name: Wolf's Fang Hood

items.description: A near unlimited source of water.
items.name: Water Well

items.description: A glistening green blade, perfectly representing the aesthetics of the year of the serpent.
items.name: Sword Of The Serpent

items.description: Those who wield this hammer do whatever it takes to be on the right side of history — that being the winning side.
items.name: The Henchman

items.description: The backpack provides ample space for storing unknown flora or newly discovered artifacts while adventuring!
items.name: Explorer Coat

items.description: A medium potted plant to beautify your home.
items.name: White Flower

items.description: Jagged fragments of dense metal. Too irregular to smelt cleanly, too valuable to discard.
items.name: Archaic Shards

items.description:
A small part of a shattered Flame mosaic. Perhaps you can piece it together if you find all the shards!

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. The full collection includes 8 pieces. They can be reassembled into a mosaic inside a Flame Mosaic Frame. The Frame must be placed on the ground.
items.name: Flame Mosaic Piece III

items.description: Blocking feels effortless in these gloves, and the crystals catch the sun with every move.
items.name: Golden Bulwark Gloves

items.description:
An underwater plant that only grows where the moonlight coats the sea floor. It has an enticing glow that spells demise for any diver willing to forget themselves in their pursuit of the light in the deep.

It can be found beneath the water in the Veilwater Basin.
items.name: Gleam Root

items.description: Footwork is the most important skill of swordsmanship. These boots should make learning the first steps easier.
items.name: Rising Fighter Boots

items.description: A display to showcase weapons or shields.
items.name: Two-Handed Melee Weapon Wall Mount

items.description: A cosy pillow with a Hophare design on it. The animal looks so lively that you think it may leap from the fabric at any moment!
items.name: Hophare Pillow

items.description: A green glowing material that's been cleansed to rid it of its toxic characteristics.
items.name: Purified Slime

items.description: A heavy blade that's split alongside the central ridge. Caution is advised, as some believe it to be a forked-tongued omen that taints the wielder's heart with lies. Yet, their caution spells weakness, and their words drip with envy... They would wield it if they could. Why shouldn't you? Shroud Imbued: This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs.
items.name: Forked Tongue

items.description:
Some fights leave scars. Others leave a fear of the undead.

Collect multiple Hollow Wispwyvern Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.
items.name: Iron Hollow Wispwyvern Trophy

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Ancient Fence

items.description: Releases an aimed ray of disastrous Shroud that continuously deals damage to enemies within. Shroud Spell: This spell results in a debuff that reduces your Time in the Shroud. Channel Spell: Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.
items.name: Shroud Beam

items.description:
Food for attracting and taming a Dune Armadillo.

To tame an animal, approach it carefully while sneaking. Throw the bait food near the animal to attract its attention. Pet the animal while it's feeding, and repeat the process until it is docile. Once tame, the animal can be picked up.
items.name: Dune Armadillo Food Bait

items.description: A broken blade, retrieved from the rubble and ash of the old world. It may still cause significant damage when in the wrong hands.
items.name: Scrappy Greatsword

items.description: A decorative Item, which will provide warmth and illumination in its proximity. Provides comfort which increases the duration of the Rested Bonus.
items.name: Large Albaneve Summits Brazier

items.description: Blocking damage has a %k chance to add %k bonus blunt damage to the next attack within the next few seconds and increases the pushback.
items.name: Gem of Retaliation

items.description: Only Draklings skilled enough earn the right to wield these adorned daggers. They often remain a trusted weapon for a lifetime. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.
items.name: Adorned Drakling Daggers

items.description: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.
items.name: Ramone Jones

items.description: A formidable shield that can keep you and your allies safe.
items.name: Valiant Shield

items.description: A simple meal, granting a lasting Melee Damage boost upon consumption. It tastes better in combination with other things, though.
items.name: Flat Bread

items.description: Simple black pants with delicate golden details. Inconspicuous on its own, but in perfect harmony with the other parts of this set. The hems have been rethreaded many times, worn thin by long journeys through Embervale. A quiet statement to the distance once walked by the "Scholars of the Empyrean".
items.name: Scholar Of The Empyrean Pants

items.description: These comfortable and plain pants are perfect for apprentices who wish to gather some firsthand adventuring experience.
items.name: Mage Trousers

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Drak Temple Vase II

items.description: Even in death, the Queen unites those who seek protection behind her shield. Parry You can block when equipped with any Melee weapon, Ward, or Shield. A well-timed block will parry the attack and fill up the enemy's Stun Bar. Wait to see a flash on the enemy or projectile to perform a parry.
items.name: Pikemead's Bulwark

items.description: This shield is adorned with a skull that spouts bloodcurdling mockery and jeers at your foes whenever you block their attacks. However, should you lose the upper hand in battle, its ridicule may fall upon you, too.
items.name: Cursed Mocking Shield

items.description: These gloves are a bit stiff and barely functional. The most important thing is that they look impressive to peasants. You won't need to do manual labor, anyway.
items.name: Royal Gloves

items.description: Fool others looking for hidden passages in your base with this fake secret door.
items.name: Fake Ancient Door

items.description: An arrow tipped with a sharp shard of Obsidian.
items.name: Obsidian Arrow

items.description: Prodigious tin armor. The glistening sheen inspires hope.
items.name: Guardian Chestplate

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Bamboo Stairs

items.description: Pants that anchor the wearer firmly on the ground through heavy fabric. While all others fall, you must remain standing... to pick them back up, to force them to continue on fighting.
items.name: Lifelock Pants

items.description: A Rough Stone Block built in the most basic manner of craftsmanship. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.
items.name: Rough Stone Block

items.description:
A model of the Veilwater Basin, complete with glistening lakes, bloodthirsty Drak, and Coconana smoothies. A treacherous paradise — what could you want more from life?

This piece is part of a greater Embervale model. To complete the miniature, all pieces must be assembled inside a frame. The pieces can be found inside the beacon dungeons and Cinder's Cradle.
items.name: Veilwater Basin Miniature Piece

items.description: The most successful, newly decorated recruits are sometimes gifted weapons dipped in gold. They aren't any sharper than their less impressive counterparts, but serve as a status symbol among the group.
items.name: Golden Recruit Axe

items.description: A Rake enhanced with scrap metal to increase its durability and speed. A decent tool to level hilly ground.
items.name: Advanced Rake

items.description:
Said to be born from lightning striking open water, the Shockfin is charged with electric energy. Be careful when trying to pull it out of the water.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.
items.name: Shockfin

items.description: Mystical gloves that have been adorned with glistening aquamarine stones.
items.name: Mystic Gloves

items.description: This draconic-looking bow was often feared for its crooked horns of unknown origin. Villagers believed that horns so twisted would always bring bad luck.
items.name: Devilish Bow

items.description: The active mycelium of mushrooms absorbs the Shroud's magical properties. Could this be used for alchemical purposes?
items.name: Active Mycelium

items.description: A bright, silvery white sand that mostly consists of crushed seashells.
items.name: Veilwater Basin Sand

items.description: These boots were made by the most talented cobblers and are as expensive as they come.
items.name: Archmage Boots

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Shield Wall Emblem I

items.description: Whether used to shoot birds from the sky or fish in the water, this bow is precise and vicious. It's definitely more stylish than a fishing rod, though it's less effective for the same purpose... perhaps its venom would be better used on other wildlife instead.
items.name: Spearfisher Bow

items.description: Hide passages in your base behind this secret door.
items.name: Secret Crude Wooden Bookshelf Door

items.description: A twisted wand emitting a faint, blue light. It demands to be wielded! Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.
items.name: Reaper's Wand

items.description: The metal adornment on this hood faintly resembles the beak of a hawk.
items.name: Fowler Helmet

items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home. Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Purple Pendant Light I

items.description: A wand that especially talented scholars of the arcane forces favor. It's versatile and reflects the wielder's brilliance. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.
items.name: Polymath's Wand

items.description:
No longer does it reach for the sorrowful and the damned. The hunger in the dark was razed. Our dreams and minds are safe, for now.

Collect multiple Fell Monstrosity Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.
items.name: Iron Fell Monstrosity Trophy

items.description: Collected in the field for alchemical use. Also works as fishing bait, favored by uncommon fish.
items.name: Moth

items.description: A buttery shortcrust pastry tart filled with fresh Prickle Pearls. Delicate and sweet with that unmistakable tickle on the tongue.
items.name: Prickle Pearl Tart

items.description: Mercenary Gloves. They're worth their weight in gold.
items.name: Mercenary Gloves

items.description: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.
items.name: Lady Leclair

items.description: A small potted plant to beautify your home.
items.name: White Flower

items.description: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.
items.name: Aunt Braelyn

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Big Furry Straw Mat

items.description: An alchemical acid used to create explosive substances.
items.name: Nitrate

items.description: A strange flask exuding a feeling of power.
items.name: Mysterious Flask

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Tarpaulin

items.description: Very few people witnessed the sharp, crystalline breath escaping <lorename>Vorgoth</lorename> from under the helmet firsthand. They saw his howl dance in the haze and felt it shiver down their skin, creep into their mind, and twist around their bones. Many did not live to tell the tale.
items.name: Guard of the North Helmet

items.description: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.
items.name: Grilled Stripetail

items.description: The pants are elegantly held together with cobalt stitching and thread. The color represents sophistication and the superiority of the mind.
items.name: Archmage Trousers

items.description: This is a showcase for Fossil Collection Items usually found in quarries, material veins, or dig sites.
items.name: Fossil Showcase (2 Small Slots)

items.description: A medium potted plant to beautify your home.
items.name: Chamomile Plant

items.description: A Regular Sandstone Block. It's very cost-efficient.
items.name: Regular Sandstone Block

items.description: A farmhand's overalls. The deep pockets are very helpful when gathering herbs or storing animal feed.
items.name: Fae Deer Farmer Overalls

items.description:
Cauterize the wound. Cleanse the spreading stain, and erase the festering blight. The light of the Flame cannot be denied.

Collect multiple Fell Thunderbrute Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.
items.name: Iron Fell Thunderbrute Trophy

items.description: A robust chest piece, adorned with the fur of a white wolf. The colors blend in well with snowed-in, grey mountains.
items.name: Wolf's Fang Chest

items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home. Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Hanging Silver Chandelier

items.description: A golden band that contains a blood-red gem; filigree lapping up around it like flames. The design was inspired by the great altar of the Mother Flame.
items.name: Ring of the Mother Flame

items.description: An ancestral weapon from the proud family line of the Galeforths, last held by Virgil Galeforth. He famously said: "If you want this weapon, you'll have to pry it from my cold, dead hands".
items.name: Ancestral Star

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Iron Prison Window Frame

items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
items.name: Reed Seedling

items.description: Designed for stealth, these neutral pants make sneaking through the thicket effortless.
items.name: Bloodfeather Pants

items.description: An Ancient tool that allows the user to wire up buttons, doors, traps, and more to make them interactable and logically interconnected.
items.name: Sparkworks Tool

items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home. Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Ceiling Lantern

items.description: A comfortable pillow with a bird on it. The bird may not be able to fly, but it still looks stylish!
items.name: Flightless Redtail Pillow

items.description: Hefty boots. They will leave considerable footprints in the ground when you defend those in need.
items.name: Guardian Boots

items.description: This is a very sophisticated bow with high tension.
items.name: Composite Bow

items.description: A pattern ripples across the fabric, creating subtle peaks and valleys as fingers draw across it.
items.name: Emberguard Pants

items.description: An imprisoned Wisp of Light. Opening the flask releases a glowing wisp that lights the darkness.
items.name: Wisp of Light

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Large Ancient Temple Shelf

items.description:
A set of orbital rings. When the inner, middle, and outer rings come together, they can display an entire planetary system.

Find all pieces and combine them on a display pillar!
items.name: Outer Orrery Rings

items.description: This sturdy oak wood bow has a high rate of fire and conserves your energy at the expense of damage.
items.name: Wildwood Shortbow

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Simple Wood Support

items.description: A basic construction material. Not very pretty, but it gets the job done. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.
items.name: Rough Wood Block

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Resource Bundle II

items.description: Its top is nearly entirely flat, its horizontal line only broken by the protruding rays of a setting sun. Pieces of cloth drape to either side, swaying in the wind like banners of an old reign.
items.name: Sunset Mace

items.description: Small fish bones that can be used in crafting. They feel brittle in your hands, but they'd be a terrible pain if stuck in your throat.
items.name: Fish Bones

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Clay Vase VI

items.description: A richly decorated and festive-looking tree.
items.name: Small Decorated Tree

items.description: A wondrous material. It is transparent and offers many potential applications, especially in building and crafting!
items.name: Glass

items.description: A simple percussion instrument used to play music. The little chimes add a nice flair to any song.
items.name: Hand Drum

items.description: These boots will still keep their shape even if you drop a hammer on them. Or tongs. Or an entire anvil. How handy!
items.name: Blacksmith Boots

items.description:
Food for attracting and taming a Yak.

To tame an animal, approach it carefully while sneaking. Throw the bait food near the animal to attract its attention. Pet the animal while it's feeding, and repeat the process until it is docile. Once tame, the animal can be picked up.
items.name: Yak Food Bait

items.description: Deep blue pants made from opaque material. With these, warmth will embrace you like a cocoon.
items.name: Efflorescent Hope Pants

items.description: Those pants go perfectly with the tunic, creating a fluent transition. They allow enough air circulation to prevent overheating during battle.
items.name: Tidecaller Pants

items.description:
A ripped piece of a wall tapestry. Find both missing pieces to reassemble the scenery!

Both pieces can be found in the Albaneve Summits.
items.name: Wall Tapestry Piece

items.description: This pair of trousers looks plain at first glance, but the craftsmanship allows the wearer to produce and retain more warmth from within.
items.name: Radiant Paladin Trousers

items.description: A mix of different biome-specific materials, mainly stone and dirt.
items.name: Veilwater Basin Rubble

items.description: A farmhand's overalls. The deep pockets are very helpful when gathering herbs or storing animal feed.
items.name: Fae Deer Farmer Overalls

items.description: Taking down prey, and even other predators is far easier with this finely made hunter's armor.
items.name: Hunter Vest

items.description: Enough to brace the worst of it, until better armor crosses your path.
items.name: Ragged Pants

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Big Yellow Wall Banner

items.description: A hammer adorned with an ancient petrified tusk. Tusks and teeth were used by the Vukah for mystical purposes.
items.name: Soothsayer

items.description: A hand scraper and sieve that can be used to mine gold and other materials underwater.
items.name: Mining Sieve

items.description: This trap door might open unexpectedly beneath your feet. Watch your step!
items.name: Trapdoor Wood 2m

items.description: A heavy club adorned with multiple wolf heads near the handle.
items.name: Wolf's Hydra

items.description: A sturdy pair of pants that will take you wherever your heart desires.
items.name: Wayfarer Pants

items.description:
It's the left arm of a fearsome Cyclops. These skeletal fists could still crush you.

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. It can be reassembled to form a Cyclops Skeleton on a Cyclops Trophy Base.
items.name: Left Cyclops Arm

items.description: Gloves with added metal rims that glisten like daggers in the dead of night.
items.name: Sky Specter Gloves

items.description: Killing an enemy has a %k chance to spawn an allied Hollow Reaper at level %k. You can only have 1 active Reaper from this gem at a time. Spawning more will delete the existing one. Reapers decay when out of combat for too long.
items.name: Gem of Greater Necromancy

items.description: A Trap Fireball which can be used as spell ammunition. Spell Charges: Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.
items.name: Trap Fireball

items.description: Many soldiers fall in war. Those who return are heralded and showered in gold and gifts; given weapons befitting a celebrated veteran... but for some, such gifts merely serve as a reminder of their harrowing past.
items.name: Golden War Hero Axe

items.description: Deep blue pants made from opaque material. With these, warmth will embrace you like a cocoon.
items.name: Efflorescent Hope Pants

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Decorative Skull III

items.description:
He reeled you in every time. Not anymore. His head's gilded and mounted, for good.

Collect multiple Scavenger Artificer Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.
items.name: Gold Scavenger Artificer Trophy

items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home. Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Iron Wall Torch

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Fine Stone Fence

items.description: A display to showcase weapons or shields.
items.name: Shield Rack

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Ceiling Chain

items.description: Blocking feels effortless in these gloves, and the crystals catch the sun with every move.
items.name: Golden Bulwark Gloves

items.description: A book. Conveyer of thought, the foundation of progress, and a bonfire of imagination.
items.name: Book I

items.description:
An explosive with astounding power that can be thrown.

The damage caused by this Throwable scales with your Dexterity attribute.
items.name: Explosive Powder Ball

items.description: A decorative item that can be placed in any building. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Granite Stone Lavatory

items.description: Don't let the image deceive you. It might look like a mace, but it's a primitive club after all.
items.name: Mace-like Club

items.description: If pure, cooked rice is a bit too plain for you, then this fried rice might satisfy your needs. The added egg breaks up the granular texture of the rice, and the vegetables create a punch of flavor!
items.name: Fried Rice

items.description: The color of life — a wonderful color for clothes.
items.name: Green Fabric

items.description:
Possessing this trophy shows everyone that you are not on the Cyclops' menu — it's the other way around!

Collect multiple Cyclops Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.
items.name: Gold Cyclops Trophy

items.description: One has to be careful when harvesting this herb, but the reward is surely worth it.
items.name: Stinging Nettle

items.description: The faded cool hue of these pants provides stark contrast to the flaming accents on the rest of the armor set.
items.name: Eagle Eye Trousers

items.description: A copper helmet that keeps your skull from harm while you protect your allies.
items.name: Tank Helmet

items.description: An infested Shroud bow, able to teach the true meaning of pain.
items.name: Banebringer

items.description: A leafy green plant material, naturally occurring in the Blackmire. It can be used for creating hedge mazes or garden artistry.
items.name: Foliage

items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
items.name: Nettle  Seedling

items.description:
An arrangement of warm grays and browns, reminiscent of a muddy brook lined by hazelnut bushes.

This color palette can be made with Springlands materials.
items.name: Cloudy Brook

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Stone Stair II

items.description: The details on this piece of upper body armor were greatly inspired by wing feathers.
items.name: Fowler Chest

items.description: A volatile, acidic fluid harvested from weak Fell Foes. Its corrosive properties make it a valuable ingredient in crafting repair kits, where its unique chemistry is harnessed to restore the durability of worn-out items. Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor.
items.name: Corrosive Blood

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Wall Tapestry V

items.description: A decorative item that can be placed in any building. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Ornate Wooden Bed

items.description: A perplexing wand, corrupted by the Shroud. It bends the mind of its bearer. Ethereal Duplication: The wand's unique magic grants it a 30% chance to spontaneously create an additional projectile. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.
items.name: Helix

items.description: A tender, raw slab of fatty meat. It is uncooked, and therefore not consumable.
items.name: Raw Fatty Meat

items.description: A staff that reigns with superior intellectual prowess, ingenuity, and near-boundless energy. It can only be wielded by the brightest minds of our time — or those who deem themselves such. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.
items.name: Luminary Staff

items.description: Firing an arrow with these gloves is effortless, creating a silky smooth stream of movement for the wearer.
items.name: Deerstalker Gloves

items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home. Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Blue Pendant Light I

items.description:
The severed head of a fearsome cyclops. It looks down on you with disdain.

Collect multiple Cyclops Heads to craft the Trophy.
items.name: Cyclops Head

items.description: Hide passages in your base behind this secret door.
items.name: Secret Basement Door

items.description: A building block crafted from White Glowing Substance. Its radiance brightens up any space. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.
items.name: White Luminescent Block

items.description: A decorative Item, which will provide warmth and illumination in its proximity. Provides comfort which increases the duration of the Rested Bonus.
items.name: Small Stone Brazier

items.description: Instantly restores a large amount of mana, and continuously replenishes it for 10 seconds.
items.name: Ancient Mana Potion +

items.description: You hold it in your hand — the Elixir still dripping from its fanged mouth. It's finally over.
items.name: Scavenger Scattershot Head

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Carved Wooden Door

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Large Bamboo Crate

items.description: Sturdy boots that withstand any march for hundreds of miles.
items.name: Exclusive Hollow Boots

items.description: A potted plant to beautify your home.
items.name: Empty Lily Pot

items.description:
Globular and small, this sea urchin looks unassuming. A keen eye, however, will notice the fivefold symmetry.

This collectible is found in the Springlands.
items.name: Round Sea Urchin

items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
items.name: Bell Pepper Seedling

items.description: A wand that harnesses the power of the eclipse. It functions best when the sun is fully submerged in darkness, and only a faint rim of light shines through. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Ethereal Duplication: The wand's unique magic grants it a 30% chance to spontaneously create an additional projectile. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.
items.name: Darya's Wand

items.description: A decorative item that can be placed in any building. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Polished Wooden Banquet Table

items.description: A ward that projects a shimmering, translucent magic shield. It has a ghostly aura.
items.name: Ghostly Ward

items.description:
This color palette blends muted orange, soft mauve, and earthy brown into a palette that feels both weathered and graceful — like warmth preserved in fading light. 

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.
items.name: Rust And Rose

items.description: This mushroom skewer will strengthen not only your flesh but also your mind. Grilled over a fire, it will raise your maximum health, increase your magic damage, and accelerate your mana regeneration.
items.name: Raw Meat and Mushroom Skewer

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Large Crypt Coffin II

items.description: Releases continuous healing projectiles that automatically seek you and your allies. Channel Spell: Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.
items.name: Eternal Heal Cascade I

items.description: A very healthy beverage that helps the body recover and prepare for the day to come.
items.name: Chamomile Tea

items.description: The tusks remain dangerous since they don't dull after death. Never stumble!
items.name: Vukah Brawler Head

items.description:
The right leg of a wild Cyclops. The skeletal remains are intact.

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. It can be reassembled to form a Cyclops Skeleton on a Cyclops Trophy Base.
items.name: Right Cyclops Leg

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Carved Tropical Wood Fence with Ropes I

items.description: A large water wheel. It can be placed in water to generate force for a mill. Must be placed near the mill.
items.name: Large Water Wheel

items.description:
A white plant called "Calla Luna". To some, they represent purity and faithfulness, while they're a symbol of sensuality to others. 
However, everybody can agree on their beauty and that their nightly green glow sets them apart from other blossoms in the Nomad Highlands.
items.name: Calla Luna

items.description: These glasses have seen countless horizons, failures, and successes. You think you can see some faint scratch marks on them — were they caused by vultures?
items.name: Loraine's Glasses

items.description: A resilient grasshopper that's adapted to the warm colors of the Nomad Highlands. It can be used as fishing bait, most likely to catch uncommon fish.
items.name: Grasshopper

items.description: A simple headscarf that will keep your scalp safe from the burning heat of the overhead sun.
items.name: Headscarf

items.description: A dark concoction distilled from enemy remains. It unveils the writings of their kin and sharpens your blade against them. Enables you to read Drakian writings and grants you additional damage against them.
items.name: Drak Soulward Flask

items.description:
The muted gray and silvery sheen cannot hide the underlying seething emerald-green envy.

This color palette can be made with Revelwood materials.
items.name: Draped In Envy

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Flag Pole V

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Big Bronze Statue "Snake"

items.description: Full metal armor with flourishing lines, swinging around the leg like ensnaring vines. Their thorns may prick, tear, and break her, but a wounded deer leaps highest, so they say.
items.name: Blood Rose Pants

items.description: Many soldiers fall in war. Those who return are heralded and showered in gold and gifts; given weapons befitting a celebrated veteran... but for some, such gifts merely serve as a reminder of their harrowing past.
items.name: Golden War Hero Axe

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Wood Banister VI

items.description: A hard lump of coal. It makes for great fuel!
items.name: Coal

items.description:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.
items.name: Dark Brown Eyes

items.description: This plantain, not to be confused with a common banana, cannot be eaten raw. It's high in starch and can be used as a staple in many foods once cooked.
items.name: Plantain

items.description: A mythical blade from long gone days. Legends say that it was passed on to Embervale by a wise spirit who descended from the stars in the year of the dragon.
items.name: Dragon Sword

items.description: The threatening teeth of a fish that is no threat anymore.
items.name: Fish Teeth

items.description:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.
items.name: Muted Red Hair

items.description: A large potted plant to beautify your home.
items.name: Heather Flower

items.description: "This simple mace hides something fantastic inside — a plethora of seeds that will help war-ridden lands recover faster after battle! With this, we'll nurture the flora of the future while defending the present! I've opted for sustainable wheat, nutritious bell peppers, and beautiful cornflowers... in a breathtaking hue of my own design." - Elder Claravinta
items.name: Claravinta's Seedling Swinger

items.description:
Opens doors in the Revelwood Hollow Halls.

Some chests in the Hollow Halls require Ectoplasm to be opened — collect enough on your descent! 
Also make sure to save some Ectoplasm for crafting Bone Keys.
items.name: Revelwood Bone Key

items.description: A shield that will provide safety and aid. For a price.
items.name: Mercenary Shield

items.description: A delicious meal with an earthy taste.
items.name: Mushroom Omelette

items.description: A medium potted plant to beautify your home.
items.name: Taro Plant

items.description: A ripped piece of fabric, detailing alchemical wisdom. Someone might be able to decipher it if you had the other half!
items.name: Ripped Alchemist's Wall Hanging

items.description: An aged stone that outlasted all else for centuries. Leaves one wondering what kind of things it might have seen.
items.name: Limestone Block

items.description: A display to showcase weapons or shields.
items.name: Wand Weapon Rack

items.description: An arrow that was embraced by eternity. It's charged with electricity. Eternal Arrow: Does not deplete Ammo per use. Equip the Eternal Arrow and use Mana to shoot it with a Bow.
items.name: Eternal Voltaic Arrow III

items.description: Conjures a slow moving ball of lightning that travels unhindered through enemies and some obstacles. It continuously releases lightning strikes to nearby enemies that also deal Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.
items.name: Eternal Ball Lightning I

items.description:
A set of orbital rings. When the inner, middle, and outer rings come together, they can display an entire planetary system.

Find all pieces and combine them on a display pillar!
items.name: Inner Orrery Rings

items.description: A poisoned Special Arrow, perfect for hunting. Poisoned Arrow: Enemies hit by this arrow are poisoned and additionally receive 16 damage per second for 5 seconds.
items.name: Poisoned Iron Arrow

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Clay Cup

items.description:
The fossilized remains of a stranded prawn. Most of its tiny legs are not visible anymore, which is mournful for researchers — but enjoyable for squeamish Flameborn.

This collectible is found in the Kindlewastes.
items.name: Prawn Fossil

items.description: This Special Arrow deals little damage but hits the target with massive force to increase the enemies' Stun Bar until they eventually become overpowered. Stun Bar increase scales with Dexterity. Stun duration depends on the enemy's size. Overpower Attacking blocking enemies or parrying their attacks fills their Stun Bar until they become overpowered. Overpowered enemies are open for Merciless Attacks.
items.name: Stun Arrow

items.description: A clear liquid with a sharp smell. Used to enhance alchemical reactions.
items.name: Alchemical Base

items.description: These are trousers that were created using superior ancient forging techniques. They bear the same mystical radial lines favoured by the ancient masters.
items.name: Crestflame Pants

items.description: A potted plant to beautify your home.
items.name: Red Flower

items.description: Grains of raw rice. They'll be very filling once cooked!
items.name: Raw Rice

items.description: Pants which shield the legs from brambles and thorns while hunting down prey.
items.name: Ranger Trousers

items.description: Fantastic gloves for digging up secrets, uncovering treasures, or cartographing never-before-seen lands!
items.name: Explorer Gloves

items.description: Mei-Yin Chen is a Lunar New Year trader offering seasonal wares. She also sells copies of cosmetic clothing items.
items.name: Mei-Yin Chen

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Straw Pile

items.description: A decorative item that can be placed in any building. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Crude Bench

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Big Stone Statue "Sword"

items.description: A reconstructed map, consisting of 4 former map pieces. It depicts a lake with an island, a river, an obelisk, and parts of a large skeleton. The full writing on the back now reads: Mae's Memoir: The first day of yearwake is unlike the rest The peaks lay quiet, licking yearfall's wounds As the sunlight sets in the faraway west On fields where sleeping buds awoke to blooms Ony's' Memoir: I fly so high, I may never come down I dance on the sun, whole body ablaze My cup's always full, I'd drink till I drown In liquid light and limerence, until I feel dazed Orpheus' Memoir: Once born a wanderer, I sought incandescence and bliss Now I'm frozen in time, my body cast in chains Accustomed to a sea of shadow, deep in the abyss My eyes hurt in the brightness, so no light may remain Polaris' Memoir: I'm a shining star, drifting high up in the sky To find your path, you must look to me only Gazing down at the world, it's hard to deny Having no one at my side makes my spirit lonely
items.name: The Dragons' Map

items.description: The crest atop this helmet stretches upwards, caressing the skies like the crown of an Ancient Spire and willing to frame within it the light of the sun.
items.name: Emberguard Helmet

items.description: Greatly regenerates Stamina upon consumption. Delightful and sweet.
items.name: Popcorn

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Huge Crypt Door

items.description: An incredibly sturdy chest piece, often worn by generals or select members of the royal guard. It inspired fear as much as respect.
items.name: Warden Chestplate

items.description: Just one look into those eyes and your enemies will want to turn the other way. That was your first line of defense, and you didn't have to lift a finger.
items.name: Golden Bulwark Helmet

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Medium Hollow's Eve Pumpkin III

items.description: A mix of soil, rock, and sediment. Drainage This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.
items.name: Blackmire Dirt

items.description: A hammer adorned with an ancient petrified tusk. Tusks and teeth were used by the Vukah for mystical purposes.
items.name: Soothsayer

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Boreal Wood Side Table

items.description: It's unclear if this Scavenger Miner Axe was ever meant to pry ore from stone, or to pierce traitors’ backs.
items.name: Scavenger Miner Axe

items.description: "Shadow Over Umber Hollow — <lorename>Lupa</lorename>" is etched on the side.
items.name: Lupa's Scalper

items.description: Click-clack, click-clack — You hear the sound of her raised heel from a mile away, piercing the ground with unyielding staccato. As her steps quicken, so does your breath. Do not get caught in her path.
items.name: Blood Rose Boots

items.description:
A bandage that was made more absorbent by moss. The added silver dust and wound ointment will cure poison.

This item heals 70% health over 10 seconds if applied to a wound. 

Receiving any damage interrupts the healing effect.
items.name: Improved Bandage

items.description: A well-fitted pair of boots to round off the Thaumaturge armor set. The purple accents create a balanced overall look.
items.name: Thaumaturge Boots

items.description:
A small part of a shattered Flame mosaic. Perhaps you can piece it together if you find all the shards!

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. The full collection includes 8 pieces. They can be reassembled into a mosaic inside a Flame Mosaic Frame. The Frame must be placed on the ground.
items.name: Flame Mosaic Piece VII

items.description: With this ward, you can conjure a nearly invisible barrier that can keep you from harm in a time of need.
items.name: Invisible Barrier Ward

items.description: A useful item for watering thirsty flowers and plants.
items.name: Watering Can

items.description: An axe made for cutting down trees. Slightly less effective for fighting off wolves.
items.name: Fenrig's Axe

items.description: A helmet which protects your sensitive cranial bone from harm while riding into battle.
items.name: Warlock Helmet

items.description: Your shots will always find their mark with these gloves.
items.name: Deadeye Gloves

items.description: Magic frames everything you do. Whatever you witness, you see through the lens of the spark — a light that lingers just outside your vision, always peering in from the edges. You serve the Flame. Do so with elegance.
items.name: Spellweaver Helmet

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Ancient Colum Base II

items.description: Ignites a fire bolt projectile that deals damage to a single target. Spell Charges: Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.
items.name: Fire Bolt I

items.description: This dusty old tome emanates a silent hate, restrained by thick iron shackles. Every fortnight, whenever this book is near, a spirited chain rattle fills the midnight air, and the pages inside convulse. It's as if something was trying to leap off the parchment to turn from ink to flesh and blood.
items.name: Tome of Agony

items.description: Releases a continuous magical beam that leeches Mana from enemies without dealing damage to them. Channel Spell: Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.
items.name: Mana Drain VII

items.description:
It's a truly inspired concoction, and vastly superior to all other currently known Health Potions.

Instantly restores a supreme amount of health.
items.name: Superior Health Potion

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Small Castle Sideboard

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Vanguard Standing Banner

items.description: A special crafting station that allows its devious users to create otherworldly ingredients.
items.name: Ectoplasm Press

items.description: A blade that's cold to the touch. It weighs heavily on the mind.
items.name: Hailscourge

items.description: A pickaxe made out of bronze. Only struggling with the hardest of stones, it can be considered very efficient.
items.name: Bronze Pickaxe

items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. This plant needs to be placed in water and submerged completely.
items.name: Algae Seedling

items.description: A heavenly instrument, previously owned by Harper Langley of The Honeydews. Its body has a beautiful carved pattern reminiscent of a mermaid's fishtail, befitting Harper's image as a siren.
items.name: Ornate Harp

items.description:
Their faces are frightening, but they mostly just want to herd goats and yaks. People only make up a small portion of their diet. 

Collect multiple Cyclops Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.
items.name: Bronze Cyclops Trophy

items.description: A medium potted plant to beautify your home.
items.name: Red Flower

items.description: Silvery like the sea glass on long-forgotten shores. Something within this ring inspires hope.
items.name: Mother's Eye

items.description:
This sea urchin sits atop a small platform and is too delicate to attempt removal. 

This collectible is found in the Springlands.
items.name: Elevated Sea Urchin

items.description:
Nutritious Fae Deer food for tame animals on your farm.

It must be placed inside the appropriate feeder.
items.name: Fae Deer Food

items.description: A delicious root vegetable that must be cooked before its sweet and mild flavor can be enjoyed.
items.name: Raw Taro

items.description: After triggering the weapons Special Ability, any kill within %k will return %k Focus.
items.name: Gem of Hyperspecialization

items.description: A lightweight, yet sturdy garnet-colored gambeson. The fire of magic burns inside. It is your duty, Flameborn, to tend to it evermore — for if you perish, the art of sorcery will die with you.
items.name: Spellweaver Chestplate

items.description: This ward creates an otherworldly light that protects the wielder from incoming damage, akin to a divine blessing.
items.name: Ethereal Ward

items.description: A mix of soil, rock, and sediment. Drainage This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.
items.name: Cinder's Cradle Dirt

items.description:
The prized head of a cyclops, preserved in metal and made accessible to the common person. People can now gaze into its eye unafraid.

Collect multiple Fell Cyclops Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.
items.name: Iron Fell Cyclops Trophy

items.description: A hood worn by ruthless people to hide their intentions. The leather trim provides additional protection and camouflages the wearer between the trees.
items.name: Marksman Hood

items.description: This Farmbed can be filled with dirt, sand, or soil to grow plants.
items.name: Empty Farmbed

items.description: A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home. There are words written on the back: "Elixir and blood, a drop for a drop." You did not hear me when last we spoke. Maybe imagery will reach you, Manny. Sorry. I know you hate it when I call you that. - J
items.name: Ashes Of Pikemead's Reach

items.description: An axe forged in pure light. Few have witnessed its glory, and those who did were blinded in a flash.
items.name: Lightforged Axe

items.description:
A feeding device that holds Hophare food.

It will feed your animals when filled with the corresponding food.
items.name: Hophare Feeder

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Carved Tropical Wood Fence Pole

items.description: A Trap Fireball which can be used as spell ammunition. Spell Charges: Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.
items.name: Trap Fireball

items.description: Headgear for herbalists. Healing others is surprisingly hard when you can't actually see them.
items.name: Herbalist Headwrap

items.description: "Shadow Over Umber Hollow — <lorename>Lupa</lorename>" is etched on the side.
items.name: Lupa's Scalper

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: High Ancient Temple Window Frame

items.description: An edible flower used to enhance the effect of certain dishes. It only blooms at night in the Springlands.
items.name: Midnight Lily

items.description: A club that was bathed in divine waters, thus acquiring a blessing of protection. Turns out blessings are less effective than cold, hard steel when caught in an ambush.
items.name: Blessed Club

items.description:
Rich, deep hues of green evoke the jungle and thickets you must navigate. A touch of red is added, like the red ginger flowers that appear here and there, breaking up the sea of green.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.
items.name: Ginger In A Jungle

items.description:
Their queen has fallen. Elixir and blood taint the mud. A soothing silence finally veils the night.

Collect multiple Scavenger Matron Helmets to craft the Iron Trophy.
items.name: Iron Scavenger Matron Trophy

items.description: These boots must've previously been worn by a solemn noble quietly roaming through the church gardens.
items.name: Noble Boots

items.description: Both a cooking ingredient and a seed for the fields.
items.name: Wheat Grains

items.description: Pants made from deep blue cloth and patched leather. The layers on the inside provide good insulation against the bitter cold.
items.name: Trailblazer Trousers

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Golden Vase Of The Ancients II

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Sandstone Fence

items.description: An axe made for cutting down trees. Slightly less effective for fighting off wolves.
items.name: Fenrig's Axe

items.description: Fool others looking for hidden passages in your base with this fake secret door.
items.name: Fake Temple Door

items.description:
The array of reds, oranges, and grays creates the ideal camouflage against the sundried mountains.

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.
items.name: Prowl

items.description: A carefully layered tunic, tied over the chest with gold string. The cloth is thick, but flowy. It will enable quick magical dashes while protecting you from the bitter cold.
items.name: Hailcaster Chest

items.description:
When the silence of the night begins to envelop the mountains, you best not step outside into the dark. Terror hides where the light does not reach.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.
items.name: New Moon

items.description: These are the buds of an algae plant. They're inedible when raw, but can be dried.
items.name: Algae Buds

items.description:
Opens doors in the Nomad Highlands Hollow Halls.

Some chests in the Hollow Halls require Ectoplasm to be opened — collect enough on your descent! 
Also make sure to save some Ectoplasm for crafting Bone Keys.
items.name: Nomad Highlands Bone Key

items.description: A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home. There are words written on the back: "The Elixir. It was a cure, a blessing, a weapon." It was difficult to capture the likeness of my Ancient companions... and my own, too, no less! My hair has gotten so long. I did not even realize until I brought it on canvas! - J

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

Food for attracting and taming a Fae Deer.

To tame an animal, approach it carefully while sneaking. Throw the bait food near the animal to attract its attention. Pet the animal while it's feeding, and repeat the process until it is docile. Once tame, the animal can be picked up.

Collect multiple Fell Sicklescythe Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.

It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.

items.description: A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home. There are words written on the back: "Once concealed by the Ancients, its might had been set free." This one's for you, Brother. I wonder... did the Wanderer speak these same words when he handed you your favorite toy? I imagine you leaning back, almost lounging in that throne like you used to. I miss that side of you. - J

items.description:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

Humanity is shown as victorious! They drive the attackers back, and the Drak are forced to retreat overseas to an archipelago.

items.description: This basic torch provides light for a short amount of time. Watch your step when exploring caves with this!
items.name: Torch

items.description: Cloth pants that are ripped and torn. A keen eye can spot sprinkles of dried blood on them.
items.name: Elite Hollow Pants

items.description: A wondrous flower known for many potential applications, but used mostly for healing purposes.
items.name: Chamomile

items.description: A delicious aggregate-accessory fruit, predominantly found in the Revelwood.
items.name: Strawberry

items.description:
The Lakehopper is an agile fish that you might see "hopping" across the surface of a shallow lake — if you're lucky.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.
items.name: Lakehopper

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Ancient Ceiling Mobile III

items.description:
A happy and carefree dog that likes to sleep in. It loves belly rubs and madly dashing in your general direction every time it sees you. 

You found this dog in a tower ruled by Hollow hounds, and a Hollow Warlock. The Warlock seemingly tried to create a vessel for a companion named "Ikko". You interrupted their ritual — but the name stuck.
items.name: Ikko

items.description: The bow curves into a zig-zag shape on both sides, capturing a vision of a rattlesnake's tail in motion.
items.name: Rattlesnake Bow

items.description: Stalking prey in these boots makes barely any sound. None will hear you coming.
items.name: Deerstalker Boots

items.description: Heads plummet to the ground, eyes shut in terror. Victims prefer darkness rather than to face the Guillotine.
items.name: Guillotine

items.description: A rose-colored piece of fresh mushroom meat. It has various applications.
items.name: Pink Mushroom Meat

items.description: In these shoes, you glide through the thicket effortlessly, barely breaking a sweat.
items.name: Quetzal Hunter Shoes

items.description: A strong bow that frames each shot between two serpents' maws. Let your arrows strike with the calculated savagery of a viper in waiting!
items.name: Bow Of The Serpent

items.description: A decorative item that can be placed in any building. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

items.name: Fine Sand

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Vertical Banner II

items.description: A bright magic shield that conjures protection from the aether when used.
items.name: Transcendental Ward

items.description:
The color of arid roads and sandy tombs.

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.
items.name: Sediment

items.description: A reconstructed map, consisting of 4 former map pieces. It depicts a lake with an island, a river, an obelisk, and parts of a large skeleton. The full writing on the back now reads: Mae's Memoir: The first day of yearwake is unlike the rest The peaks lay quiet, licking yearfall's wounds As the sunlight sets in the faraway west On fields where sleeping buds awoke to blooms Ony's' Memoir: I fly so high, I may never come down I dance on the sun, whole body ablaze My cup's always full, I'd drink till I drown In liquid light and limerence, until I feel dazed Orpheus' Memoir: Once born a wanderer, I sought incandescence and bliss Now I'm frozen in time, my body cast in chains Accustomed to a sea of shadow, deep in the abyss My eyes hurt in the brightness, so no light may remain Polaris' Memoir: I'm a shining star, drifting high up in the sky To find your path, you must look to me only Gazing down at the world, it's hard to deny Having no one at my side makes my spirit lonely
items.name: The Dragons' Map

items.name: Basket I

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Vertical Banner III

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

items.description: This garment is held together by oakwood buttons, a woven belt, and magic itself! The buttons are doing most of the work, though.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.

items.description: No one has ever cut one from rock — only found where the Ancients have passed. Maybe they've brought it to Embervale from wherever they originated.

Although you have been exposed to this sight countless times, it still exudes a sense of menace and excitement at the same time.

Collect multiple Fell Monstrosity Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

items.description: Designed for stealth, these neutral pants make sneaking through the thicket effortless.

items.description: A luscious, dyed fabric, usually reserved for creating the finest garments.

The right arm of a Cyclops. It's taller than your whole body when propped up!

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. It can be reassembled to form a Cyclops Skeleton on a Cyclops Trophy Base.

items.description: The cloth straps attached to this mask glide softly in the breeze, helping to discern wind direction and speed.

items.description: Fresh, healthy, fun to eat, and good for the soul. What more could you want from a meal?

items.description: An axe made for cutting down trees. Slightly less effective for fighting off wolves.

items.description:
When you stand opposite this face, you remember its screams. "Zzzrrr Krrrraallllll Hrrrrggg" it echoes in your head, only this time you don't have to feel weak in the knees.

Collect multiple Hydrak'Dal Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.
items.name: Iron Hydrak'Dal Trophy

items.description: This garment is held together by oakwood buttons, a woven belt, and magic itself! The buttons are doing most of the work, though.

items.description: "Shadow Over Umber Hollow — <lorename>Lupa</lorename>" is etched on the side.
items.name: Lupa's Scalper

"Glimmer Gentian" is a variant of the gentian plant that can only be found in the Albaneve Summits at night.

It emits a bright pink glow and can be used to create vibrant color palettes.
items.name: Glimmer Gentian

items.description: A friendly figure made from snow.

items.description:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.
items.name: Purple Eyes

items.name: Pearlfrost Mentor Gloves

items.description:
A feeding device that holds Fae Deer food.

It will feed your animals when filled with the corresponding food.

items.description: The banana and honey combine to create a smooth and creamy sweetness. A delicacy for any Flameborn with a sweet tooth!

items.description: The added leather grants superior protection from jagged rocks, unruly tree bark, and incoming arrows.
items.name: Cutthroat Trousers

items.description: An arrow with a steel tip.

A radiant whirl of energy that is needed to insert gems into weaponry. 

While initially used by the Ancients, it was claimed by the Fell to fuel their brood until you freed it from its newly organic prison.

items.description:
Large, in charge, and ready to barge in while you are busy scavenging caves.

Collect multiple Cyclops Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.
items.name: Iron Cyclops Trophy

items.description: A bitter tasting herb that can be found in dry areas. It's said to have enlightening abilities.
items.name: Sage Leaves

items.description: The fabric of this coat is thick enough to protect against incoming blows. Additionally, the inner lining follows the direction of the body's veins, allowing the wearer to unleash short-range magic more easily.

items.description: Marked through hundreds of hours of enduring the force of fire, this wand has a connection to the element and is able to utilize it. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

items.description: A mythical blade from long gone days. Legends say that it was passed on to Embervale by a wise spirit who descended from the stars in the year of the dragon.

The inside of the helmet is strangely damp. There's sticky residue everywhere.

Collect multiple Scavenger Matron Helmets to craft the Bronze Trophy.
items.name: Bronze Scavenger Matron Trophy

items.description: They unveil their true power during the solstice, as if they were recharged and invigorated by the sun's rays. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

items.description: When placed, the eye slowly becomes something more than just a core again. Thin layers of skin reform around it, forming a heavy eyelid that never fully closes.

items.description: A foregone history tome presented on an iron stand.

Possessing this golden trophy proves that you dodged every sword blow and defeated your opponent with concentrated force.

Collect multiple Fell Thunderbrute Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.

This collectible is found in the Springlands.

A tiny frog. He could be your best friend if you didn't need to use him as fish bait.
