items.description: A finely handcrafted bow, used by seasoned woodland hunters.
items.name: Hunter's Bow

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: High Ornamented Stone Window Frame

items.description:
A broken piece of the Queen <lorename>Pikemead</lorename> sculpture.
Find every piece to reassemble a statue.
items.name: Queen Pikemead Statue Piece

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Pinewood Fence Gate II

items.description: A bow used by Commanders of the Northern Guard. A powerful energy flows through the user, increasing their pulse and allowing for faster shots.
items.name: Talion's Bow

items.description: Rectangular flints reach outwards from the blade's core, some as big as your fist. Their peaks and valleys make up the image of a gargantuan spine befitting an apex predator — hence the reference to the drakian god who strove for dominion of the continent.
items.name: Spine Of Dalszul

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Jezmina's War Banner I

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Wood Banister II

items.description: A wanderer's boots, worn but still sturdy enough to carry your burdens on your journey.
items.name: Wanderer's Boots

items.description: A light pair of boots that allow for swift movements when wading through snow and blizzards. You can scout the frozen fringes of the mountains for miles when wearing these shoes!
items.name: Alpine Antler Boots

items.description:
A stone with multiple large ammonite imprints. There's a bewitching spiral shape on every side of it.

This collectible is found in the Springlands.
items.name: Ammonite Imprint

items.description: An object that allows you to display your instruments.
items.name: Instrument Stand

items.description: This regal soldier's armor symbolizes chivalry, glory, and valor.
items.name: Soldier Chestplate

items.description: A fanciful hood with expressive animal ears and a draping cape. It's made from layers of faintly dotted fur and is well-suited for walking among the Fae Deer as a trusted friend and companion.
items.name: Fae Deer Farmer Hood

items.description: Gigantic, sturdy, and bone-chilling.
items.name: Icy Giant Bones

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Ancient Microscope I

items.description: A popular plant due to its strong fibers. It can be used to make linen.
items.name: Flax

items.description: A shingle block in blue hues, used in the angled rooftops of the Kindlewastes.
items.name: Desert Shingle Roof Block

items.description: Fine, dark sand found along volcanic shorelines.
items.name: Cinder's Cradle Sand

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Red Marble Column Base II

items.description: A golden urn with intricate ornaments in the shape of an eerie skull. The lateral detailing resembles fangs or claws.
items.name: Foreboding Golden Urn

items.description: Releases continuous lightning strikes that can arc to multiple other close targets. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar. Channel Spell: Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.
items.name: Eternal Arc Lightning II

items.description: Quickly dash to the rescue in these comfortable and snug boots!
items.name: Herbalist Boots

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Conifer Crate

items.description: This pickaxe can help you dig deeper and further due to the pick having been forged from steel. Heave ho!
items.name: Steel Pickaxe

items.description: A mythical blade from long gone days. Legends say that it was passed on to Embervale by a wise spirit who descended from the stars in the year of the dragon.
items.name: Dragon Sword

items.description: The radiant golden glow of this helmet recalls the bright spirit of the previous owner. In Embervale, this helmet was reserved for only the brightest thinkers, whose intellect lit the way.
items.name: Scholar Of The Empyrean Helmet

items.description:
Still waters are deep, so they say. These serene blue hues remind us that things aren't always as they seem — for both depths and dewdropped thicket hide fateful encounters.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.
items.name: Revelation By The Pond

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Fur Rug

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Bamboo Door

items.description: A very durable and long-lasting source of light made from wax. Equip this before starting your expeditions into the unknown!
items.name: Wax Torch

items.description: Summons a totem that launches fiery projectiles at enemies and explodes when it expires. Maximum amount of summoned totems is 1 by default which can be increased via skills. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.
items.name: Eternal Fire Totem II

items.description: This Farmbed can be filled with dirt, sand, or soil to grow plants.
items.name: Empty Farmbed

items.description: Ignites a fireball projectile that erupts upon impact and deals damage in an area. Spell Charges: Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.
items.name: Fireball I

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Prison Room Divider I

items.description: Beware of the Spike Traps. When they are activated, they will hurt more than stepping on a small children's block toy.
items.name: Spike Trap

items.description: This armor was conceived to restrain and control the wearer's smoldering magical energy within. If worn by a mere apprentice rather than an elder, it could make their heart stop!
items.name: Elder Chest

items.description: This drain will remove any water above it. Can be placed on the floor.
items.name: Stone Floor Drain

items.description: A natural plant, remains of the agriculture left behind, that grows in the world. It offers protection from the elements when used as building material.
items.name: Straw

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: High Elegant Armchair

items.description: Command respect with this Warden Helmet.
items.name: Warden Helmet

items.description: Killing an enemy with a Sneak Attack or Merciless Attack has a %k chance to spawn a level %k companion skull.
items.name: Gem of Skulls

items.description:
A radiant whirl of energy that is needed to insert gems into weaponry. 

While initially used by the Ancients, it was claimed by the Fell to fuel their brood until you freed it from its newly organic prison.
items.name: Archaic Essence III

items.description: A bulky, circular shield that almost appears to possess a glowing energy core. With this, your defense will be powered up greatly!
items.name: Crestflame Shield

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Flag Pole IV

items.description: A decoratively wrapped present box.
items.name: Yellow Decorative Box

items.description:
Good omens fell to ash. Lights turned to lies, not promises. What was once a sign of good fortune has been snuffed out by a brush with fate. <lorename>Pikemead</lorename>'s glory is restored.

Collect multiple Fell Wispwyvern Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.
items.name: Iron Fell Wispwyvern Trophy

items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home. Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Lamp

items.description: The sun won't drown in the darkness of night. It will rise again.
items.name: Sun Hammer

items.description: A mix of soil, rock, and sediment. Drainage This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.
items.name: Revelwood Dirt

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Big Waggon

items.description: A rugged-looking stone road material made from jagged rocks. Be careful where you step!
items.name: Rocky Stone Road Block

items.description: This stone serves as the centerpiece of a mill.
items.name: Improved Millstone

items.description: Calls down a disastrous Shroud Meteor on up to five foes. Shroud Spell: This spell results in a debuff that reduces your Time in the Shroud. Spell Charges: Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.
items.name: Shroud Meteor

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Tombstone "Until We Meet Again"

items.description:
Bronze seeps into the newly formed flesh, binding eyelid and tendrils into a unified shell.

Collect multiple <lorename>Vorgoth</lorename> Eyes to craft the Bronze Trophy.
items.name: Bronze Vorgoth's Eye Trophy

items.description:
Life isn't always black and white. Sometimes, power demands sacrifice.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.
items.name: Kingmaker

items.description: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.
items.name: Anton Godwin

items.description: An elegantly twisted metal headband, adorned with an eye-catching stone.
items.name: Noble Diadem

items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home. Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Crypt Skull Torch

items.description:
The fossilized remains of a lobe-finned fish. Descendants of this nocturnal drift-hunter were considered a delicacy and used to populate brooks and springs. However, consumption became impossible during the reign of the Shroud, as some fish developed new rows of rotting teeth and bit back.

This collectible is found in the Kindlewastes.
items.name: Fish Fossil

items.description: A medium potted plant to beautify your home.
items.name: Sage Plant

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Large Palm Wood Cabinet

items.description: Find the foe's weakness, then aim, breathe, and shoot. Nothing can escape your arrows when the Flame lights their path.
items.name: Wildheart Gloves

items.description: A dark and dreary set of gloves. They make spellcasting feel ominous!
items.name: Wizard Gloves

items.description: A highly polished version of the granite wall block. Possible imperfections were largely removed, creating a more seamless finish.
items.name: Polished Granite Block

items.description: Roll out the red carpet whenever you wish, and make your entrance in style.
items.name: Red Carpet Block

items.description:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.
items.name: Saturated Pink Hair

items.description: A strange ring that seems to hold an entire, nebulous world in the stone that adorns it.
items.name: Ring of the Ether

items.description: Crystallized from evaporated ectoplasm and bonemeal. Used to craft bone keys or decorative furniture.
items.name: Ectoplasm Gem

items.description: Light boots. They're slightly pointed at the toes.
items.name: Mage Boots

items.description: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.
items.name: Nameless One

items.description: Place this Flame Altar above the Shroud to mark your home. Build inside the marked area around the Flame Altar.
items.name: Flame Altar

items.description: This royal chest piece frames a gleaming gem as its heart, reminding the wearer that hope will prevail. Taupe colored sleeves drape at the sides like a chrysalis being shed. The shoulders are accentuated by wing- or petal-like shapes, blossoming outwards.
items.name: Efflorescent Hope Chest

items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested repeatedly.
items.name: Banana Seedling

items.description: Even in death, the Queen unites those who seek protection behind her shield. Parry You can block when equipped with any Melee weapon, Ward, or Shield. A well-timed block will parry the attack and fill up the enemy's Stun Bar. Wait to see a flash on the enemy or projectile to perform a parry.
items.name: Pikemead's Bulwark

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Iron Fence

items.description: Before the fall, many guards and knights of Embervale would brandish swords such as these. Perhaps their spirit lives on through your righteous strikes.
items.name: Greatsword Of The Old Order

items.description: Red - the color of the Flame fitting for a Flameborn!
items.name: Red Fabric

items.description: Summons a totem that launches icy projectiles at enemies, applying a slow debuff to them. Maximum amount of summoned totems is 1 by default which can be increased via skills. Spell Charges: Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.
items.name: Ice Totem II

items.description: A decorative item that can be placed in any building. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Bamboo Bench

items.description: Refined gloves that offer both protection and maneuverability for the fingers. Wearing them makes one feel as though they can work with utmost precision and concentration.
items.name: Artificer's Gloves

items.description: This material glows in a warm white light. It's an alchemical miracle!
items.name: White Glowing Substance

items.description: A large potted plant to beautify your home.
items.name: Indigo Plant

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Carved Wooden Double Door

items.description: When placed in competent hands, this horned bow can fire a shot so powerful that it may loosen an avalanche, and bury the valleys in everlasting snow.
items.name: Avalanche Starter

items.description: A very basic set of garments.
items.name: Threadbare Pants

items.description: Artificial nails were added to these otherwise simple mage gloves to make them more imposing and fashionable.
items.name: Mage Gloves

items.description: A floppy hat with red feathers.
items.name: Flame Pact Hat

items.description: "Embervale is nothing but a speck of dust; a single point in time from which we will propel ourselves forward. We'll leap from here, into the future — towards the stars above. Towards home. No matter where we land... we will make our mark. They will remember us. They will remember me." - Manathor
items.name: Manathor's Greatsword

items.description: A rudimentary set of daggers, the secondary weapon of choice for archers. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.
items.name: Daggers

items.description: A hearty feast that fortifies your body. Grilled over a fire, this skewer will increase your melee damage, boost your maximum health, and accelerate your health regeneration.
items.name: Raw Meat and Corncob Skewer

items.description: A formidable greatsword, forged with a copper and tin alloy. Its maker took the time to carefully etch harmoniously flowing lines into it, which spill from the ricasso towards the centre of the blade.
items.name: Bronze-engraved Greatsword

items.description:
A deep, royal purple dominates this color palette. The color seems to draw you in like the glimmering inside of an amethyst geode.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.
items.name: Dusk Amethyst

items.description: Knightly pants. The cloth attached brandishes a glorious golden thread.
items.name: Knight Trousers

items.description: A sturdy shield carried by the Fell. It has held up through many crusades.
items.name: Fell Crusader Shield

items.description: Wrapped in darkened leather and shrouded in mystery, these boots carry the wearer as if on clouds.
items.name: Eagle Eye Boots

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Clay Vase I

items.description: Pierce your foes through the heart — using your horns isn’t necessary.
items.name: Skull Stalker Helmet

items.description: A blade that's cold to the touch. It weighs heavily on the mind.
items.name: Hailscourge

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Crypt Fence

items.description: A hunter's favorite ration, crafted for precision. After you've grilled it over a fire, it will grant you more maximum health, increase your ranged and dagger damage, and expand your maximum stamina.
items.name: Raw Meat and Tomato Skewer

items.description: A decorative item that can be placed in any building. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Salon Stool

items.description: Heavy gloves, held together by pairs of belts and buckles. With these, you can grab whoever dares to threaten the Mother Flame straight by their wretched throat.
items.name: Crestflame Gloves

items.description: An advanced arrow with a bronze tip.
items.name: Bronze Arrow

items.description: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.
items.name: Galen Yager

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Room Divider III

items.description: These bellows are needed to craft a blast furnace.
items.name: Bellows

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Blackmire Temple Door

items.description: The path of the scout is a little easier on quiet soles.
items.name: Scout Boots

items.description:
At this point, you're a professional at not getting crushed by skeletal fury — and this trophy is proof of it.

Collect multiple Hollow Wispwyvern Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.
items.name: Gold Hollow Wispwyvern Trophy

items.description: Peppery, sweet, and packing a punch — this candied ginger is a great snack for anyone not afraid of strong flavours.
items.name: Candied Ginger

items.description: A staff that harnesses the power of the eclipsed sun. It functions best when only a crescent of light is left. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.
items.name: Darya's Staff

items.description: A small, round Flightless Redtail baby. Even at this age, their beak can cause some damage. Don't get pecked!
items.name: Baby Flightless Redtail

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Graveyard Fence Broken II

items.description: A shield that was washed into a grotto by the river. It must have belonged to a valiant hero.
items.name: Riptide

items.description: A massive formation of ectoplasm crystals, pulsing with energy. An enormous life force is trapped within — and has been for a very long time.
items.name: Ectoplasm Aggregate

items.description: The time for glory is now. Bask in its glow. Music Sheet: Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.
items.name: Pikemead's Peak

items.description:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

Flames swallow a town, and the sky is set alight. Chaos reigns as the Drak reappear in the Veilwater Basin. No defenders are visible.
items.name: Drak Relief VI

items.description:
Softspoken, sandy browns, and bright ash colors give this palette a dusty, but distinguished look.

This color palette can be made with Revelwood materials.
items.name: Antique

items.description: A bow used by Commanders of the Northern Guard. A powerful energy flows through the user, increasing their pulse and allowing for faster shots.
items.name: Talion's Bow

items.description: A fanciful hood with expressive animal ears and a draping cape. It's made from layers of faintly dotted fur and is well-suited for walking among the Fae Deer as a trusted friend and companion.
items.name: Fae Deer Farmer Hood

items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
items.name: Sage Seedling

items.description: Hide passages in your base behind this secret door.
items.name: Secret Ancient Door

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Crystal Cup

items.description: No mage armor set is complete without a large, brimmed hat.
items.name: Mage Hat

items.description: Your steps will be quick and quiet, and your strikes will be deadly.
items.name: Assassin Boots

items.description: The fragment of a torn treasure map, found on a dragon skeleton in the Albaneve Summits. Perhaps you could reconstruct the map if you found all pieces? There's writing on the back: Orpheus' Memoir: Once born a wanderer, I sought incandescence and bliss Now I'm frozen in time, my body cast in chains Accustomed to a sea of shadow, deep in the abyss My eyes hurt in the brightness, so no light may remain
items.name: Orpheus' Map Piece

items.description:
Remains of a wandering specter, doomed to wither on the mortal plane. Its lips are sealed, its eyes are forever shut. The evil has been cast out.

Collect multiple Fell Sicklescythe Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.
items.name: Iron Fell Sicklescythe Trophy

items.description:
A large and slender sea lily, reaching up towards the surface and sky. If it had any sense of perception, it'd be able to judge the rise and fall of the sea, as well as the looming change in the waters.

This collectible is found in the Nomad Highlands.
items.name: Larger Sea Lily Fossil

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Large Crypt Coffin I

items.description: A massive ocular core, torn from <lorename>Vorgoth</lorename>, or what was left of him. Inside, faint arcs of energy still flicker.
items.name: Vorgoth's Eye

items.description: A headwrap that protects your sensitive skull from traumatic injury. Enough to postpone the inevitable for a while.
items.name: Healer Headwrap

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Large Golden Room Divider

items.description: The scales are still warm when removed from the fish. They never fully cool and are popular under fire mages for obvious reasons.
items.name: Fish Scales

items.description: A classic pair of gloves. Don't they make you want to throw a snowball?
items.name: Winterly Gloves

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Veilwater Basin Boardwalk II

items.description: Summons a totem that launches shock projectiles at enemies that also deal Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar. Maximum amount of summoned totems is 1 by default which can be increased via skills. Spell Charges: Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.
items.name: Shock Totem I

items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home. Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Firefly Chandelier

items.description: A mix of soil, rock, and sediment. Drainage This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.
items.name: Fertile Cinder's Cradle Dirt

items.description: This chest piece includes a silky white undergarment for warmth and a flowy cerulean cape for further insulation, and dramatic effect.
items.name: Thaumaturge Chest

items.description:
This magical small chest offers increased storage space for items. 

The items stored here can be used for crafting purposes from anywhere in the base!
items.name: Small Magic Chest

items.description:
As its distinctive appearance suggests, the Thornridge is an epic fish that only a very skilled fisher can catch.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.
items.name: Thornridge

items.description: A nice, cream-colored hood to keep you warm and snug. The droopy little ears are purely fashionable, but aren't they cute?
items.name: Fluffy Hood

items.description:
Unknown footprints in the mud are always a bad omen, wether one is superstitious or not.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.
items.name: Omen Boots

items.description: An arrow with a copper tip.
items.name: Copper Arrow

items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
items.name: Shrub Seedling

items.description: A strange wand that was covered by ashes. Its body bends and twists, but never breaks. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.
items.name: Cryptic Wand

items.description: A glistening green blade, perfectly representing the aesthetics of the year of the serpent.
items.name: Sword Of The Serpent

items.description:
Opens doors in the Kindlewastes Hollow Halls.

Some chests in the Hollow Halls require Ectoplasm to be opened — collect enough on your descent! 
Also make sure to save some Ectoplasm for crafting Bone Keys.
items.name: Kindlewastes Bone Key

items.description: An extension to your backpack that enlarges your inventory by two rows. Outdated This item is of an old design. Visit your craftsmen to find an improved version of the backpack with an additional row.
items.name: Medium Backpack

items.description: These fingerless gloves allow the wearer to feel each leaf and root before picking, allowing a proper assessment.
items.name: Herbalist Gloves

items.description: A standing sign that you can write on.
items.name: Ground Sign

items.description: This ring will increase your mana and its replenishment.
items.name: Ancient Ring of Mana

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Standing Wooden Barrel

items.description: Conjures a flurry homing bone projectiles that hunt down enemies with crushing force. Channel Spell: Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.
items.name: Bonestorm V

items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home. Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Astronomy Wall Lamp

items.description: A mix of different biome-specific materials, mainly stone and dirt.
items.name: Kindlewastes Rubble

items.description:
The snarling lips and crushing fangs remind you of the countless fights you had with the Direwolf.

Collect multiple Direwolf Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.
items.name: Iron Direwolf Trophy

items.description: A sword with a reinforced, pointed edge that can cut through any growth in the thicket. The blade is also useful for hunting wildlife.
items.name: Explorer's Machete

items.description: A formidable chest piece, decorated with many elements resembling nature, vines, and petals.
items.name: Hawk Chest

items.description: If anyone dares to engage you in close combat, they'll get a taste of your wildly thrashing spiked shoulder pads. Your defense will be impenetrable, and the cuts you'll leave will be deep.
items.name: Brazen Bull Chest

items.description: These gloves prevent the bowstring from digging into the skin while lining up shots.
items.name: Marksman Gloves

items.description: Instantly restores a medium amount of mana, and continuously replenishes it for 10 seconds.
items.name: Greater Mana Potion +

items.description: A refreshing bottle of Water that grants more Stamina. Stay hydrated.
items.name: Water

items.description: Royal gloves, befitting a true knight of honor.
items.name: Knight Gloves

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: High Polished Window Frame

items.description: This ring will increase your health and healing rate.
items.name: Ring of Health

items.description: An item of power. Feed it to the Flame to gain its strength.
items.name: Skill Point

items.description: A heavy weapon, fit for descending any abyss — both literally and figuratively. Shroud Imbued: This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs.
items.name: Abysswalker

items.description: Lord Vorgoth's once-trusted blade was discarded before the war and replaced by a weapon more befitting vile acts. It still clings to a semblance of sanity and light, shining brightly in the dark like the North Star.
items.name: Guard Of The North Sword

items.description: They can barely be called boots.
items.name: Ragged Boots

items.description: This Axe is destined to smite down creatures of the wild.
items.name: Wolf Pack Axe

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Vanguard Wall Banner

items.description: Used to build thatched roofs. A basic and reliable solution to keep your head from getting wet. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.
items.name: Plant Fiber Roof Block

items.description: A delicate flute, decorated with swift aquamarine brushstrokes that carry the tones forth like silvery winds.
items.name: Exceptional Flute

items.description: Fine particles that shimmer faintly, leaving a cold blue trace on whatever they settle on.
items.name: Moonstone Dust

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Bamboo Barricade IV

items.description: Hardened scales of wild animals. Some say they are as hard as stone.
items.name: Scales

items.description: An ancient ring that gives you stamina.
items.name: Ultimate Ring of Stamina

items.description: No one will get through you whilst you stand your ground in these regal boots.
items.name: Brazen Bull Boots

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Fine Hardwood Fence Pole

items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home. Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Orange Floor Light II

items.description: It burns the palms when wielded without caution, leaving blisters and pain even as the heat of battle fades.
items.name: Calescent Axe

items.description: A lumpy ball of snow. It's harmless enough as long as you don't put any rocks inside!
items.name: Snowball

items.description: A resplendent white-and-gold cloak interwoven with iridescent threads. Worn by the "Scholars of the Young Flame", it symbolizes the burning desire to illuminate the unknown.
items.name: Scholar of the Young Flame Cloak

items.description: A decorative item that can be placed in any building. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Granite Stone Sink

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Castle Wall Shelf

items.description:
Once thought to be a path to redemption turned into a path to damnation. Fortunately, the Flame was strong enough to avert greater disasters several times.

Collect multiple Fell Wispwyvern Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.
items.name: Gold Fell Wispwyvern Trophy

items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home. Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Wall Mounted Candleholder

items.description: No need to keep these boots clean and neat. They will get bloody. Your teammates will make sure of that.
items.name: Healer Boots

items.description:
Fresh Shroud spores, used to craft medicines that can cure the Shroud curse.

They first appear in the Springlands at night, among groups of Fell enemies above the Shroud.
items.name: Fresh Shroud Spore

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Coffin Lid

items.description:
If these brittle flakes are not handled carefully, they can fall apart and stick to everything, especially clothes.

It's unusable by itself, but can be processed into different materials in crafting.
items.name: Brittle Shroud Flakes

items.description: A chainmail coif, crowned with a wreath of roses and thorns. Beauty and pain, pleasure and despair — they all coalesce in her halo.
items.name: Blood Rose Mail Coif

items.description: Few enemies can withstand even an unarmed blow dealt with these gloves.
items.name: Soldier Gloves

items.description: A crisp, vibrant red bell pepper with a sweet, juicy flavor and a glossy skin.
items.name: Bell Pepper

items.description: The cloth of these billowy pants falls in ripples like waves in the cerulean sea.
items.name: Siren Seeker Pants

items.description: A bow that aims to strike the heart of the dark with silver-tipped arrows and no hesitation.
items.name: Silvershot Bow

items.description: A mix of soil, rock, and sediment. Drainage This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.
items.name: Veilwater Basin Dirt

items.description: Decorative bells are especially suitable for the yearfall.
items.name: Decorative Bells III

items.description: When the remaining time in the Shroud is below %k, defeated enemies drop time replenishing Orbs.
items.name: Gem of Hopeful Embers

items.description: When wounded warriors see this hat peak up from the horizon, they know salvation is near. Then they notice that the hat is a little bit cone-shaped. They usually don't say anything about it, though.
items.name: Pearlfrost Mentor Hat

items.description:
Dark chestnut-colored pants. They're less frayed and battered than the remainder of the Omen's armor.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.
items.name: Omen Trousers

items.description: A heavy club adorned with multiple wolf heads near the handle.
items.name: Wolf's Hydra

items.description: This ceremonial wand was often used when praying for downpours when the drought first started. While that didn't work, you can still use it to call lightning down on your enemies! Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.
items.name: Ritual Tempest Wand

items.description: Wearing these gloves makes the pulse slow down mysteriously before going in for the kill, thus steadying the hands.
items.name: Fowler Gloves

items.description:
A small part of a shattered Flame mosaic. Perhaps you can piece it together if you find all the shards!

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. The full collection includes 8 pieces. They can be reassembled into a mosaic inside a Flame Mosaic Frame. The Frame must be placed on the ground.
items.name: Flame Mosaic Piece I

items.description: The Drak decorate their settlements with such trophies. It's impressive that they even washed off the blood — they surely reuse it for other purposes...
items.name: Skull Trophy II

items.description: This protective juice of trees has many functions. First and foremost, serving the cause of the trees!
items.name: Resin

items.description: A pair of warm pants, tinged in a deep blue. It provides ample protection from the elements.
items.name: Pearlfrost Mentor Pants

items.description: A six-edged mace made from heavy metal. The head of this weapon resembles a star.
items.name: Metalstar Mace

items.description: These simple, comfortable boots are perfect for taking a stroll on a warm summer's day.
items.name: Sunny Loungewear Boots

items.description: Used in a <craftingstation>Smelter</craftingstation> to melt ores and create alloys.
items.name: Crucible

items.description: A simple, light chest piece to complement the rest of the armor.
items.name: Scout Chest

items.description: Fine iron dust, used for different crafting purposes.
items.name: Iron Dust

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Ancient Column

items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil.
items.name: Revelwood Red Leaf Seedling

items.description: This is an elevated version of the Boreal Axe. Its head boasts an intricate design, typical for northern craftsmanship.
items.name: Darkwood Axe

items.description: Gleaming golden gloves were the mark of a Scholar in motion, swift of thought and radiant of heart.
items.name: Scholar of the Young Flame Gloves

items.description: Lightning and ice fuse together to unleash a groundbreaking force. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.
items.name: Silver Storm

items.description: A pair of thick gloves, stuffed with warm, white fur. The area around the back of the wrist is shielded with a small metal plate.
items.name: Alpine Antler Gloves

items.description:
Its spotted skin secretes a numbing poison. The pattern is a warning, not a decoration.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.
items.name: Specklefin

items.description: A decoratively wrapped present box.
items.name: Orange Decorative Box

items.description: An elegant dual dagger set with extravagant gold detailing. It's slim enough to be smuggled underneath a nightgown unseen into any chamber. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.
items.name: Baroness Daggers

items.description: A violet dye, often used in the creation of opulent garments for royals.
items.name: Mauveine

items.description: A scrumptious curry with lots of heat and depth of flavor. It will make you feel warm and cozy!
items.name: Taro Root Curry

items.description: A decorative item that can be placed in any building. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Wooden Tavern Counter

items.description:
After performing an evade action, the next hit deals %k additional cutting damage and replenishes 
%k stamina on the next hit.
items.name: Gem of Agility

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Scrap Vat II

items.description: A decorative item that can be placed in any building. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Spellweaver Throne

items.description: An axe with a very sturdy iron head. It's more efficient!
items.name: Iron Axe

items.description: This trap door might open unexpectedly beneath your feet. Watch your step!
items.name: Trapdoor Stone 2m

items.description: A pair of circus knives that can do a lot of damage if left in untrained hands! Better watch out! Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.
items.name: Circus Knives

items.description: This tool can only be used inside the building area around a Flame Altar. It can help you to quickly build your desired base with pre-defined structures.
items.name: Rock 2m

items.description: The blades thicken and slim periodically in subtle waves, as if they were forged from pure, liquid light. Be careful not to blind yourself when wielding these in battle! Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.
items.name: Daggers Of Liquid Light

items.description: Striking with staggering force, this hammer obliterates the Hollow by grinding their bones to dust. Hollow Echo: The weapon unleashes an unholy echo that magically extends the attack range.
items.name: Mandible Crusher

items.description: A versatile and durable material that is smooth to the touch. It also has the advantage of being waterproof.
items.name: Leather

items.description: A potted plant to beautify your home.
items.name: Empty Cymbidium Pot

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Bamboo Crate I

items.description: A once pristine weapon. Now decayed but still just as deadly.
items.name: Stonewrought Sword

items.description: A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home. There are words written on the back: "Long ago, a wanderer brought an enthralling gift to the people of Embervale." I so wonder what sort of day it was — I chose to paint the sky as overcast; but whether the air was joyous or heavy, I could not know... - J
items.name: Beginning Of The End

items.description: The wilderness will bend to your will in no time when you face it wearing these sturdy, bite-proof boots.
items.name: Explorer Boots

items.description: A wand that burns with the same destructive force that has razed villages, libraries, and museums. Artefacts and tomes, burnt to a crisp and falling to dust... can you wield this power responsibly? Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.
items.name: Ashwood Wand

items.description: A hood and mask. The latter reminds you of a bird of prey, ready to descend on its enemies at high noon. Your shadow will be the last they'll ever see.
items.name: Wildheart Hood

items.description: The <npc>Alchemist</npc> Balthazar brews potions and other concoctions.
items.name: Balthazar

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Awning III

items.description: Those who wield the Drak'Dal Chieftain Axe command great awe — one swing is enough to bring a tribe to its knees. It's taken many lives, and lusts for countless more.
items.name: Drak'Dal Chieftain Axe

items.description: Take a moment to appreciate this fascinating flower and its beautiful pink color.
items.name: Passionflower

items.description:
The chalky white and vibrant pink in this palette form a childlike innocence.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.
items.name: Pinky Promise

items.description: Some farmers believe that wizards store their magical energy in their brimmed hats. These rumors were widespread but false. Mostly.
items.name: Wizard Hat

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Clay Vase V

items.description: A decorative item that can be placed in any building. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Palm Wood Chair

items.description:
A big and heavy chest that offers fantastic storage space for countless items.

The items stored here can be used for crafting purposes from anywhere in the base!
items.name: Huge Magic Chest

items.description: A Special Arrow that delivers an explosive surprise. Strikes with immense firepower.
items.name: Exploding Arrow IV

items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home. Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Small Ancient Ground Lamp

items.description: A decoratively wrapped present box.
items.name: Green Decorative Box

items.description: An iron blade erupts from the golden handle, splitting it like a growing sprig leaping through gilded leaves. Hope always finds a way to grow, even in the darkest of times.
items.name: Bright Hope Sword

items.description: They don't offer much protection, but enhance your magical abilities. The minimalist design also prevents you from getting sweaty hands.
items.name: Tidecaller Gloves

items.description: The light sweetness of the coconut rice pairs well with the smoky fish filet. A shame you couldn't add a hint of lime or lemon!
items.name: Grilled Fish with Coconut Rice

items.description: This striped cat is a fearsome hunter, always on the prowl. It's quiet, graceful, independent — and proud to present its spoils of war to you after a successful hunt! After a long day of adventuring though, it loves nothing more than to snuggle and sleep.
items.name: Tyger

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Silver Bowl

items.description: Simple but reliable protection for hands.
items.name: Fur Gloves

items.description: A wand that crackles with energy as it nurtures spark and flame. While wielding it, you feel as though it may burst into flame at any moment. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.
items.name: Cracklewood Wand

items.description: A luminous greatsword that reaches towards the sun above like a rekindled fire. It slashes through the night with vigor, creating light in the dark.
items.name: Greatsword Of Embers

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Handrail

items.description: This head armor combines a mask, cloth, and horns. For most foes, it will be the last thing they see when you catch them by surprise.
items.name: Bloodfeather Helmet

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Boreal Wood Door

items.description: A shiny pair of boots. They're so heavy that you'll practically be immovable when wearing them.
items.name: Tank Boots

items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home. Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Iron Chandelier

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Palm Leaf Basket

items.description: A beautiful yellow flower with magical properties that increases the user's mana.
items.name: Aureolin Flower

items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
items.name: Strawberry Seedling

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Bamboo Window III

items.description:
Even the most gruesome creatures must bend to the Flame, no matter their size. At least the slushing sounds inside its dome have subsided.

Collect multiple Fell Thunderbrute Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.
items.name: Bronze Fell Thunderbrute Trophy

items.description: A handy machine that brews hot coffee. There is hope left in this world after all.
items.name: Coffee Brewery

items.description: Gold veins flow through these gloves like sun-kissed rivers emerging after an icy slumber. The color of the underlying cloth changes from blue to green, symbolizing an awakening — a reach toward the light above the water's surface.
items.name: Efflorescent Hope Gloves

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Small Mortar

items.description: At first glance, these brown leather boots appear ordinary. A closer inspection reveals the cloven segment towards the front, which leaves "hoov"-like prints in the mud.
items.name: Fae Deer Farmer Boots

items.description:
A cool gray reminiscent of cathedral walls, eternal in its grace and silence.

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.
items.name: Cathedral

items.description: A weapon that was rumored to have fallen from the stars. The man who found it could never feel whole, always searching for a missing piece.
items.name: Lesser Golden Twinflame Sword

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Large Boreal Wood Cupboard

items.description: A strange wand that was covered by ashes. Its body bends and twists, but never breaks. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.
items.name: Cryptic Wand

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Waggon

items.description:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.
items.name: Saturated Green Hair

items.description: Conjures a freezing storm that continuously deals damage to all enemies inside the area and applies a slow debuff to them. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.
items.name: Eternal Blizzard I

items.description: Crystalline, ice-cold, and slippery.
items.name: Ice

items.description: An accurate bow imbued with the mysterious powers of the Shroud.
items.name: Shadowbane

items.description:
The surface gleams so bright and the plume becomes a radiant crown, turning the helmet into something ceremonial. Fitting for celebrating your multiple defeats.

Collect multiple Hollow Titan Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.
items.name: Gold Hollow Titan Trophy

items.description:
The fur is still speckled with bloody flecks.

Collect multiple Vukah Brawler Heads to craft the Trophy.
items.name: Vukah Brawler Trophy

items.description: A larger storage opportunity for bulk items.
items.name: Large Chest

items.description: The fragment of a torn treasure map, found on a dragon skeleton in the Albaneve Summits. Perhaps you could reconstruct the map if you found all pieces? There's writing on the back: Mae's Memoir: The first day of yearwake is unlike the rest The peaks lay quiet, licking yearfall's wounds As the sunlight sets in the faraway west On fields where sleeping buds awoke to blooms
items.name: Mae's Map Piece

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Palm Leaf Basket

items.description: A freshly brewed cup of coffee. The flavor is strong, bold, and lightly acidic. What better way to start the day?
items.name: Black Coffee

items.description: Comfortable trousers for long walks.
items.name: Alchemist Apprentice Trousers

items.description: Big and bulky gloves, usually worn when wielding large weaponry and shields.
items.name: Guardian Gloves

items.description:
A statue of the late queen <lorename>Pikemead</lorename>. An engraving on the bottom reads: 

Gather 'round, we're drinkin'! 
An ode to the Queen, once young! 
3 babes on 'er arm, cup filled to the brim. 
Thinkin' out loud, she'd sung!
items.name: Statue of Queen Pikemead

items.description: A battered metal shield that allows you to block and parry physical attacks. Young squires tend to place all their hope in these... until the metal starts to bend and give. Parry You can block when equipped with any Melee weapon, Ward, or Shield. A well-timed block will parry the attack and fill up the enemy's Stun Bar. Wait to see a flash on the enemy or projectile to perform a parry.
items.name: Fell Defender Shield

items.description: If you can't beat them, join them. This Special Arrow uses the power of the Shroud and disperses a cloud of it upon impact.
items.name: Shroud Arrow II

items.description: The great Fell Thunderbrute Greatsword — shrunken for your convenience.
items.name: Fell Thunderbrute Greatsword

items.description: A metal <keyitem>Kettle</keyitem> which can be suspended over a <craftingstation>Cooking Station</craftingstation>.
items.name: Kettle

items.description: A mix of soil, rock, and sediment. Drainage This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.
items.name: Fertile Blackmire Dirt

items.description: A combination of rust-red fabric, metal plates, and gold accents. The latter usually matches the Hollow's gold teeth!
items.name: Elite Hollow Chestplate

items.description: A fully grown Round-Billed Sailer, willing to donate fresh feathers for your cause.
items.name: Round-Billed Sailer

items.description: Conjures a flurry homing bone projectiles that hunt down enemies with crushing force. Channel Spell: Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.
items.name: Bonestorm IV

items.description: Instantly restores a small amount of mana, and continuously replenishes it for 10 seconds.
items.name: Mana Potion +

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Coffin

items.description: The pants might not look like much, but they actually do their job of protecting your life in battle.
items.name: Golden Bulwark Pants

items.description:
Inside, you can see nothingness. The absence of matter — of sanity and sanctum.

Collect multiple Fell Monstrosity Heads to craft the Trophy.
items.name: Fell Monstrosity Trophy

items.description:
A mushroom that is commonly found beneath the Shroud. 
It's inedible but can be processed into different materials in crafting.
items.name: Shroud Mushroom

items.description: Ground up coals, creating a highly flammable powder.
items.name: Coal Powder

items.description: These capybara bristles can be woven into your clothing to help you glide through the water more easily and prevent you from cooling down too quickly.
items.name: Capybara Bristles

items.description: These leg guards protect the wearer's sides from incoming strikes.
items.name: Brazen Bull Trousers

items.description: A small potted plant to beautify your home.
items.name: Grass

items.description: An extension to your backpack that enlarges your inventory by one row. Outdated This item is of an old design. Visit your craftsmen to find an improved version of the backpack with an additional row.
items.name: Small Backpack

items.description: Sweet, sticky fruits of the date palm. Travelers swear by them for a quick recovery on the road.
items.name: Date

items.description: A large potted plant to beautify your home.
items.name: Licuala Plant

items.description:
An explosive with astounding power that can be thrown.

The damage caused by this Throwable scales with your Dexterity attribute.
items.name: Explosive Powder Ball Net

items.description: A layered gambeson that's wrapped in chains and free-flowing silk. Its dark color scheme makes it easy to walk the path of ash and dust unseen.
items.name: Ashwind Strider Chest

items.description: A mix of different biome-specific materials, mainly stone and dirt.
items.name: Springlands Rubble

items.description: No need to keep these boots clean and neat. They will get bloody. Your teammates will make sure of that.
items.name: Healer Boots

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Stone Column

items.description: Pumpkins are beloved for their sweet, earthy flavor in cooking and their sturdy, hollow shells for festive crafts.
items.name: Pumpkin

items.description: Legends say that these gloves once belonged to a dark ruler whose name has been wiped from the history books.
items.name: Gloom Monarch Gloves

items.description: With these sturdy shingles, your house is well protected.
items.name: Shell Limestone Shingles

items.description: Releases a continuous magical beam that leeches Mana from enemies without dealing damage to them. Channel Spell: Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff. Hold the input to channel it over time.
items.name: Mana Drain II

items.description: A book. Conveyer of thought, the foundation of progress, and a bonfire of imagination.
items.name: Book I

items.description: Sharp claws and a sharper tongue that refuses to be silenced — such is both sword and shield of the Blood Rose.
items.name: Blood Rose Gloves

items.description: A wonderfully inviting fireplace made from red bricks.
items.name: Brick Fireplace

items.description: A simple setup for basic grinding work. Especially good for hard ingredients.
items.name: Grinding Stones

items.description: These fireworks were brought to you by the wonders of alchemy!
items.name: Blue Confetti Mortar

items.description: An important workplace for a <npc>Carpenter</npc> which will enable many new crafting opportunities.
items.name: Table Saw

items.description: These Daggers are adorned with crystal inlays shaped like eyes, a constant reminder to their wielders that the Broodmother Vesztah watches them at all times. It is believed that she guides their hand — ensuring that only the strongest may hatch, while the weak are struck down by the blade's edge. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.
items.name: Broodmother’s Eye

items.description: Violet blood. It runs cold, and the consistency is somewhat syrupy.
items.name: Drak Blood

items.description: Summons a Hollow Wretch ally that attacks enemies. Maximum amount of summoned Hollow allies is 1 by default which can be increased via skills. Spell Charges: Depletes one charge per use. Equip the spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.
items.name: Hollow Wretch II

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Drak Temple Vase III

items.description: An expertly crafted blade, balanced and sharp. Cuts through foes like a wail through the night. It bears the mark of a famous blacksmith from Pikemead's Reach.
items.name: Wailing Blade

items.description: An honorable greatsword that resembles the Motherflame herself. Wield it with passion — and caution. Carrying this sword binds one to duty!
items.name: Greatsword Of The Motherflame

items.description: A comfortable and noble doublet with a little cape attached to it. Every design element was carefully chosen to create an honorable look.
items.name: Royal Doublet

items.description:
A set of orbital rings. When the inner, middle, and outer rings come together, they can display an entire planetary system.

Find all pieces and combine them on a display pillar!
items.name: Middle Orrery Rings

items.description: A light pair of boots that allow for swift movements when wading through snow and blizzards. You can scout the frozen fringes of the mountains for miles when wearing these shoes!
items.name: Alpine Antler Boots

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Fish Drying Rack

items.description: A broad ring that invokes power through golden glyphs. Spherical discs and tori orbit a central gem, like planetary rings, as the stone in their midst shimmers with unknown colors.
items.name: Ring of the Ancients

items.description: A decorative item that can be placed in any building. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Boreal Wood Bed

items.description: Light brown pants. Comfortable and distinguished in their simplicity.
items.name: Flame Pact Pants

items.description: They don't offer much protection, but enhance your magical abilities. The minimalist design also prevents you from getting sweaty hands.
items.name: Tidecaller Gloves

items.description: A tainted blade. Fading memories still reverberate from it, but the man who was once haunted by them is long gone. You freed Embervale — and him, too.
items.name: Shroud Vessel's Greatsword

items.description:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.
items.name: Black Hair

items.description: Sheets melted out of Metal Scraps to make them more workable and open up options for further processing.
items.name: Metal Sheets

items.description: This armor provides perfect protection when venturing out into the forest.
items.name: Hunter Garb

items.description: A tiny potted plant to beautify your home.
items.name: Pink Flower

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Steel Bucket

items.description: You'll make people shake in their boots when you approach in these spooky shoes!
items.name: Hollow's Eve Boots

items.description: You feel calm and guarded in this upper body armor — consider your next move carefully.
items.name: Skull Stalker Chest

items.description: Filled with the burning Spark of the Flame, it's a valuable asset in the fight against the Shroud. It increases the time you can withstand the Shroud.
items.name: Ring of the Flame

items.description: A plant known for its flowers and the deep blue organic pigment that can be won by processing it.
items.name: Indigo Plant

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.name: Water Trough

items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home. Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.
items.name: Purple Wall Light II

items.description:
Each of her glowing eyes feels like a remnant of one of her whips — echoes of a violence that is no longer there.

Collect multiple Scavenger Tyrant Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.
items.name: Bronze Scavenger Tyrant Trophy

items.description: A simple but reliable helmet. You might still get a bump or two if you get hit, but that's part of the fun.
items.name: Adventurer Helmet

items.description: Magnificent pants, worn by the most battlehardened and sagacious wizards.
items.name: Elder Trousers

items.description: A display to showcase weapons or shields.
items.name: Staff Weapon Rack

items.description: A large and powerful hammer that has been corrupted by the Shroud. Good for smashing bugs!
items.name: Dreadbane

items.description: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.
items.name: Grilled Shockfin

items.description: A young Round-Billed Sailer, unable to fly yet due to its overly round shape and tiny wings.
items.name: Baby Round-Billed Sailer

items.description:
Refreshing like a salty gust of wind from the ocean.

This color palette can be made with Revelwood materials.
items.name: Seafoam

items.description: A staff that harnesses the power of the eclipsed sun. It functions best when only a crescent of light is left. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.
items.name: Darya's Staff

items.description: A large gland filled with a lethal substance. Handle it with care!
items.name: Toxic Sack

items.description: A stunning painting that can be displayed in your home. There are words written on the back: "The Shroud, a ruinous fog which sought only to spread and devour." It's a terrifying sight... but packed tightly against the light of the morning sun. I wanted to show that there is still hope... somewhere out there. - J
items.name: The Horde Unleashed

items.description: This magician's headgear frames the wearer's face with a luscious golden trim.
items.name: Magician Hat

items.description: A blade that seems to be forged from ice itself.
items.name: Icefang Blade

items.description: A venerated chestplate that reflects the light of the Mother Flame on its polished, angular surface. Anyone who brandishes this armor vows to be the sword of the Flame and the guard of the light.
items.name: Emberguard Chestplate

items.description: Sprays a lingering, poisonous acid in a cone in front of the caster. It also breaks the armor of enemies, applying a debuff which lets them take 25% increased physical damage for a short duration. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete Spell Charges per use. Equip the Eternal Spell and use Mana to cast it with a Staff.
items.name: Eternal Acid Bite I

items.description: Roasted with a smoky aroma, it's a real pleasure for the taste buds, able to set free all of its strengthening attributes.
items.name: Roasted Corncob

items.description: Polstered trousers to dampen your fall in fighting practice.
items.name: Rising Fighter Trousers

items.description: A book. Conveyer of thought, the foundation of progress, and a bonfire of imagination.
items.name: Book IV

items.description: A strange wand that was covered by ashes. Its body bends and twists, but never breaks. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.
items.name: Cryptic Wand
